-Tracking metrics and performance reports.

-Providing mentorship and feedback to team members.



Content Quality & Execution

-Oversee content quality and ensure deliverables meet standards.

-Supervise scheduling and posting across platforms according to content calendars.

-Ensure deadlines and client expectations are consistently met.



Analytics & Reporting

-Track, analyze, and report social media performance metrics.

-Provide insights to improve content strategy and engagement.

-Demonstrate value to clients through clear reporting.



Client & Team Communication

-Maintain regular communication with clients and internal teams.

-Provide updates, gather feedback, and ensure smooth collaboration.



Ad Hoc Content Support

-Conduct research, assist in content creation, and manage posting as needed.



Qualifications:

-Proven experience managing social media campaigns

-Strong copywriting, content creation, and creative direction skills.

, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.).

What You’ll Be Responsible For



Local SEO



* Optimize and maintain our Google Business Profile

* Improve Google Maps and local search visibility

* Research local and service-based keywords

* Improve local citations and NAP consistency

* Identify local backlink and partnership opportunities

* Analyze competitors ranking in our local market

* Recommend strategies to increase local authority and reviews



Website SEO



* Perform SEO audits and identify priority issues

* Improve title tags, headings, page structure, and internal linking

* Identify crawl, indexing, sitemap, and technical SEO issues

* Recommend or implement schema markup

* Improve service pages and location pages

* Monitor website health and Core Web Vitals

* Work with our website developer when technical changes are needed



Keyword & Content Strategy



* Perform keyword research and search-intent analysis

* Identify new service page opportunities

* Identify valuable location-based opportunities

* Optimize existing website content

* Find content gaps compared with competitors

* Create SEO recommendations and content briefs when needed

* Help build topical authority around our services



Backlinks & Authority Building



* Conduct competitor backlink research

* Identify legitimate backlink opportunities

* Perform ethical outreach

* Identify local publications, venues, organizations, and businesses that may provide relevant link opportunities

* Find and recover unlinked brand mentions



We are not interested in spammy backlinks, black-hat SEO, fake reviews, mass-produced low-quality AI content, or shortcuts that could hurt our websites long term.



Analytics & Reporting



You should be comfortable working with:



* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics 4

* Google Business Profile

* Ahrefs and/or Semrush

* Screaming Frog or similar tools



You will provide clear monthly reporting showing:



* Organic traffic performance

* Keyword movement

* Organic leads or conversions

* Google Business Profile performance

* SEO work completed

* Backlinks earned

* Issues discovered

* Recommended priorities for the next month



What We’re Looking For



We prefer candidates with:



* 2–3+ years of hands-on SEO experience

* Strong Local SEO experience

* Google Business Profile optimization experience

* Experience working with local or service-based businesses

* Strong keyword research skills

* On-page SEO experience

* Working technical SEO knowledge

* Google Search Console and GA4 experience

* Ethical backlink-building experience

* Strong written English

* Good communication and organization

* Ability to work independently and take initiative



Experience with WordPress, Elementor, BrightLocal, Whitespark, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, or 
 is a plus, but you do not need experience with every tool.



What Success Looks Like



Over time, we want to see:



* Better rankings for valuable local keywords

* Increased Google Maps visibility

* More qualified organic traffic

* More catering inquiries from search

* Stronger service and location pages

* Better website health

* More high-quality backlinks

* Stronger local authority



We care about real business growth and qualified leads, not just vanity metrics.



How to Apply



Start your application with:



“Organic Growth Wins.”



Please send:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile

2. Your weekly availability

3. Two SEO case studies or websites you personally worked on

4. Before-and-after results if available

5. A short explanation of exactly what you personally handled on each project



Please answer the following questions:



1. What experience do you have with Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization?



2. If you were given a catering website in Naples, Florida, what are the first five things you would audit?



3. Tell us about one SEO project where you improved traffic, rankings, or leads. What did you personally do?



4. What strategies do you use to earn legitimate backlinks?



5. Which SEO tools do you use most often and why?



Hiring Process



Qualified candidates will complete:



1. Application review

2. Short video interview

3. Paid SEO skills assessment

4. Final interview



Finalists may be asked to review one of our websites and provide:



* Major SEO issues

* Local SEO opportunities

* Keyword opportunities

* Competitor observations

* Content recommendations

* Backlink opportunities

* A prioritized 90-day action plan



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, takes ownership of their work, and wants to grow alongside our brands.

title: Wholesale & Faire Operations Specialist (Remote)

MAU Brands is a private-label ecommerce company operating since 2016 across Home & Kitchen, Office, Outdoor, and Stationery. We sell on Amazon (US/CA/UK/EU), Walmart, Best Buy, and Shopify, and we're expanding our wholesale channel. We're a fully remote global team.

5. Meticulous attention to detail and strong written English

To apply

Start your application with the word WHOLESALE so we know you read this carefully. Applications without the keyword will not be reviewed.

title: Operations & Growth VA – Airbnb / Booking.com / Short-Term Let Management
description:
Please read this carefully before applying.



We are not looking for a basic VA or someone who only wants easy admin tasks.



We are looking for a reliable, sharp and proactive tea
mber who can support the day-to-day operations and growth of a UK short-term-let management company.



This role is for someone who learns quickly, follows instructions properly, communicates clearly in English and can solve problems without needing constant supervision.



Please do not apply if any of the below apply to you:

Your ID score is below 90

Your English level is below C1

You have less than 1 year of hands-on Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Agoda, Expedia or short-term-let experience

You are currently working multiple full-time jobs or have commitments that will affect your focus

You cannot work during UK hours

You are not comfortable speaking and writing in English

You need constant step-by-step supervision for every task

You use ChatGPT to write generic answers without understanding the role



About AirUs:

We are a growing UK short-term-let management company.



We manage properties across different cities and work with guests, property owners, cleaners, contractors and booking platforms every day.



Our standards are high. We care about guest experience, owner trust, reviews, revenue, compliance and smooth operations.



This role combines:

Day-to-day operations

Guest communication

Owner support

Cleaner and contractor coordination

Problem solving

SOP improvement

Growth support

Lead follow-up

Client acquisition support



This is a serious long-term role for the right person.



About the role:

You will be helping us keep operations running smoothly while also supporting business growth.



You must be able to:

Think clearly under pressure

Follow instructions properly

Learn quickly

Communicate confidently in English

Take ownership of problems

Spot issues before they become bigger problems

Suggest better ways of working

Use ChatGPT / Claude properly to improve speed and quality

Handle guests, cleaners, owners and leads professionally



This role will start part-time at 20 hours per week at $4 per hour during the initial trial period.



If you prove you are the right person, hours and rate can increase based on performance.



UK working hours are preferred.



Key responsibilities:

Handle guest messages calmly, quickly and professionally

Resolve guest issues within agreed boundaries

Coordinate cleaners, contractors and internal tea
mbers

Check that properties are ready for guest arrivals

Protect reviews, ratings and brand reputation

Update property owners clearly when issues happen

Follow existing SOPs correctly

Create and improve SOPs where needed

Identify recurring problems and help fix the root cause

Follow up leads and potential new clients

Support outreach to landlords, investors and property owners

Help improve systems, templates and workflows

Use ChatGPT / Claude to improve communication, outreach and efficiency



Growth responsibilities



This is not just an inbox role.



We want someone who can also help the business grow.



This may include:

Following up inbound leads

Contacting potential landlords, investors and property owners

Helping with outreach messages

Tracking leads properly

Supporting basic negotiation

Improving owner communication

Helping improve listings and guest experience

Identifying weak points in the business

Suggesting ways to improve revenue, reviews or operations



Required skills and experience:

Minimum 1 year hands-on Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Agoda, Expedia or short-term-let experience

Excellent written and spoken English, C1 or above

Strong problem-solving ability

Clear communication

Good judgement under pressure

Strong organisation and time management

Ability to follow instructions exactly

Comfortable using ChatGPT or Claude for real work tasks

Commercial mindset, not just task completion

Confident speaking to guests, cleaners, owners and leads

Proactive and able to work without micromanagement



Nice to have:

Experience with PMS software

Experience with PriceLabs, Beyond or dynamic pricing tools

Experience with CRM or lead tracking

Experience with SOPs and process documentation

Experience with social media, outreach or basic marketing

Experience working with UK, US, Canadian or Australian clients



What success looks like after 90 days:

Guest messages are handled quickly and confidently

Issues are resolved without unnecessary escalation

Owners receive clear and professional updates

Cleaner and contractor communication is organised

SOPs are followed and improved

Leads are followed up consistently

You identify problems before being told

You suggest better ways of working

You become someone the business can rely on



Important application instructions:

To prove you have read the full description, include the word airus26 at the very top of your application.



Then answer the following questions clearly:

Confirm your English level.

Confirm your ID score.

Confirm how many jobs you are currently working.

Confirm your Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Agoda, Expedia or short-term-let experience.



Q1 – Too many tasks at once

You start the day with 15 planned tasks.

By midday, 5 urgent issues appear:

A guest cannot access a property

A cleaner says they cannot attend a same-day turnover

An owner is asking for an urgent update

A new landlord lead is ready for a call

A guest is asking for a refund due to a minor issue



How do you d
 what gets done today and what gets pushed back?



In your answer, explain:

Your priority order

What you handle immediately

What you acknowledge but schedule later

What you escalate

How you make sure nothing gets forgotten

How you communicate delays to stakeholders

What gets moved to tomorrow and why



Q2 – Lead follow-up and growth

A landlord lead spoke to us last week and seemed interested, but has not replied since.

They own a 3-bedroom property in a good area. They told us they are comparing us with another management company and are mainly worried about fees.



What would you do next?



In your answer, explain:

What follow-up message you would send

What value points you would focus on

What proof or reassurance you would provide

How you would avoid sounding desperate

How many times you would follow up before closing the lead

What you would record in the CRM or tracker

What would make this a good or bad lead



Q3 – AI use in operations and growth

We expect this role to use ChatGPT or Claude properly, not lazily.

Give two specific examples of how you would use AI in this role.



Your answer must include:

One example for improving operations

One example for helping business growth

What information you would give the AI

How you would check the output before using it

One thing you would never allow AI to d
 on its own



Applications will be rejected if:

You do not include airus26

You do not answer the questions

Your answers are vague or generic

Your answers look fully copied from ChatGPT

You do not have relevant short-term-let experience

You are working multiple full-time jobs

You cannot work during UK hours



Hiring process:

Shortlisted candidates will proceed to the next stage of the hiring process.



The full hiring process may include:

Further written assessment

Short video test

Practical operations task

Final interview

Paid trial for the strongest candidate



We are looking for someone who is honest, sharp, reliable, fast to learn and serious about building a long-term role with our company.

title: Properties Administrator
description:
Role Overview

The Properties Administrator supports the safe, compliant and efficient operation of SSV properties by coordinating maintenance and repairs, maintaining accurate property records, monitoring statutory and service renewals, and providing timely updates to staff, landlords, contractors and management. The role acts as a central administrative point for property concerns from initial report through completion and close-out.



NOTE: Make sure to attach a CV to your message, via document or link so we can contact you.



Key Responsibilities



1. Property Maintenance and Repairs

- Receive, review and accurately log property maintenance concerns raised by staff across SSV locations.

- Assess the information provided, obtain supporting photos or videos where required, and clarify the issue before arranging action.

- Coordinate repair and maintenance services with appropriate contractors, including plumbers, electricians, handymen, cleaners and locksmiths.

- Schedule appointments, property visits and inspections using
, telephone and approved messaging channels.

- Monitor outstanding concerns, follow up proactively, record progress and ensure completed cases are closed with appropriate evidence.

- Escalate urgent, high-risk, safeguarding-related or repeatedly unresolved property issues to the designated manager without delay.



2. Communication and Stakeholder Coordination

- Serve as a key administrative contact between property staff, landlords, contractors, service providers and SSV management.

- Monitor and respond professionally to property-related
s, calls, messages and voi
s within agreed response times.

- Provide clear updates on appointments, repair status, inspections, delays, access requirements and completed work.

- Follow up on pending responses and maintain an accurate communication trail for each property issue.



3. Property Compliance and Documentation

- Maintain a schedule of expiry and renewal dates for property-related certificates, assessments and insurance documentation.

- Arrange or support the booking of Gas Safety Certificates, fire extinguisher servicing, PAT testing, Fire Risk Assessments and Legionella Risk Assessments.

- Request renewal certificates and supporting documents, verify that records are complete, and file them in the correct location.

- Notify management of upcoming expiries, missed appointments, overdue documentation or identified compliance risks.



4. Property Logs and Management Reporting

- Maintain daily property concern logs, maintenance trackers, spreadsheets and databases with accurate and current information.

- Monitor staff completion of daily property logs, including confirmation of 'No Concern' where no issue is reported.

- Track open actions, due dates, repair completion and unresolved risks, and provide regular status updates to management.

- Keep supporting evidence, correspondence and completion records organised and audit-ready.



5. Contractor, Quotation and Invoice Administration

- Research suitable contractors and suppliers based on service needs, location, availability, cost and reliability.

- Obtain and compare quotations for proposed works and present options for approval in line with SSV processes.

- Book approved contractors, confirm appointment details, and track attendance and completion of work.

- Collect invoices, verify that they relate to completed or authorised work, and attach them to the relevant tracker for payment processing.

- Generate property-related invoices or payment documentation when assigned and maintain clear supporting records.



6. Deliveries, Inventory and Procurement Support

- Monitor expected parcel and equipment deliveries through the designated tracker.

- Confirm receipt with property staff, investigate missing or delayed items, and update delivery records promptly.

- Research potential sellers and purchasing options for property supplies, furniture or equipment using approved vendors and marketplaces.

- Support procurement activity by documenting options, prices and order or delivery status.



7. Council Tax and Utility Administration

- Support the set-up and maintenance of council tax accounts for applicable SSV properties.

- Prepare and submit council tax exemption applications where applicable and authorised.

- Update the relevant tracker and securely save account records, correspondence and supporting documents.

- Follow up with councils or service providers on outstanding actions and escalate material issues.



8. Additional Property and Operational Administration

- Manage property-related calendars, draft letters and maintenance requests, and maintain organised electronic files.

- Update the handyman's daily attendance and timesheet records accurately and on time.

- File assigned young-person medication tracker lists and monthly reports in the designated secure folders, following confidentiality and access-control requirements.

- Complete other reasonable property or operational administration tasks assigned by the line manager.



Core Competencies

- Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate property records, trackers, certificates, invoices, and supporting documentation.

- Organisation & Time Management - Manages multiple maintenance concerns, appointments, renewals, and deadlines efficiently.

- Communication & Coordination - Communicates clearly and professionally with staff, landlords, contractors, service providers, and management.

- Problem-Solving Skills - Assesses property concerns, researches suitable solutions, and takes appropriate action to resolve issues.

- Contractor & Supplier Management - Coordinates contractors, obtains quotations, compares options, and monitors work through completion.

- Compliance Awareness - Monitors property certification and renewal requirements and escalates overdue or high-risk matters promptly.

- Accountability & Follow-Through - Takes ownership of property concerns and ensures actions are monitored through to completion and closure.

- Administrative & Technical Proficiency - Confidently uses spreadsheets, trackers, shared drives,
, calendars, and communication platforms.

- Prioritisation & Risk Awareness - Recognises urgent maintenance, safety, safeguarding, and compliance concerns requiring immediate escalation.

- Confidentiality & Data Security - Handles property, staff, financial, and young-person information securely and responsibly.

title: Customer Service and Scheduling Assistant
description:
# Remote Customer Service and Scheduling Assistant



**Location:** Philippines

**Company:** Cityscape Appliance Repair LLC

**Target start date:** Middle of October 2026



Cityscape Appliance Repair is a small and growing appliance repair company serving Massachusetts and the surrounding area. We are looking for a dependable and friendly person to handle our customer calls, texts, and
s.



We hope to find someone interested in staying with us, learning our business, and growing alongside the company. We want to be honest about the schedule, pay, workload, training, and what we will expect from you.



## Schedule



The schedule is Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time.



This position follows Eastern Time throughout the year. Your corresponding schedule in the Philippines will change by one hour when the United States changes its clocks.



You will receive one unpaid hour for lunch. You may take the full hour at once or divide it into two 30 minute periods.



You will also receive two paid 15 minute breaks.



You are guaranteed 40 paid hours each week.



This is an overnight schedule in the Philippines. Please consider carefully whether you can work these hours consistently.



## Compensation and Growth



Starting pay is **$3.25 USD per hour**.



You are guaranteed **$130 USD per week** during your first 90 days.



After 90 days, your pay will increase to **$4 USD per hour**.



You will then be guaranteed **$160 USD per week**.



Pay will be sent weekly through an agreed electronic payment service.



The position includes 13th month pay. Approved overtime and any additional pay required by applicable law will be paid separately.



Your guaranteed weekly pay will remain the same during slow and busy weeks as long as you remain available and complete your scheduled hours.



We want this to become a lasting position. As Cityscape grows, and as you learn the business and take on more responsibility, there will be opportunities for additional pay increases and a larger role within the company.



## Workload and Downtime



The workload will change from day to day. Some days may be completely full. Other days may have substantial downtime. All scheduled downtime is paid.



We do not expect you to pretend to be busy. During quiet periods, we would like you to check for missed calls, texts,
s, voi
s, and other unfinished customer communication.



You can also use quiet time to review our policies, improve your knowledge of the business, and look for reasonable ways to be helpful. Please ask us before taking on unfamiliar tasks.



You must remain available and responsive throughout your scheduled hours, including during slower periods.



## Primary Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include answering incoming calls through Talkroute and making outgoing calls to customers.



You will return missed calls and voi
s, respond to customer texts and
s, and schedule, reschedule, and confirm service appointments.



You will gather complete and accurate customer information, follow our written policies, and explain basic information about our service.



You will keep clear customer notes and follow up with customers who have not responded.



You must also recognize when Nikki or I need to answer a question. You will keep us updated about customers who need a return call, text response, clarification, or additional assistance. Customer questions should not be forgotten simply because we were unavailable when the customer first contacted us.



## Training and Independence



We have limited time for extensive live training. We will provide the important information, instructions, access, and guidance you need to begin.



You must be able to learn quickly, take useful notes, follow written procedures, and ask clear questions when you are uncertain.



We are not looking to micromanage. We want someone we can trust to remain available, notice what needs attention, make reasonable decisions, and let us know when help is required.



Previous experience with telephone calls, scheduling, office administration, or customer service is preferred. Appliance repair experience is not required.



## Communication and AI



We use AI as a helpful tool, but we are hiring a person to communicate with our customers.



Customers should receive a genuine human interaction. You may use AI to help with grammar, organization, or drafting. However, you are responsible for reviewing, correcting, and personalizing everything before sending it. Customer responses should not be copied directly from AI without being carefully reviewed.



If you use AI to help complete your application, please tell us.



Your application must also include at least one paragraph written entirely in your own words. Place an asterisk at the beginning and end of that paragraph so we can identify it.



Example:



*This paragraph was written entirely in my own words.*



## Other Employment



You may have another job as long as it does not interfere with this position.



During your scheduled Cityscape hours, another job cannot cause you to miss calls, delay responses, leave your work area, or become unavailable.



Customer calls and messages from Cityscape must receive your attention when they arrive.



## Internet, Electricity, and Workspace



You will need a dependable computer, reliable internet service, reliable electricity, a clear headset or microphone, and a quiet place where you can speak with customers professionally.



A backup option for electricity or internet is helpful, but it is not required. We would like to know whether you have a backup and how often you normally experience internet or power interruptions.



## Paid Time Off and Holidays



Your birthday will be a paid day off.



After completing six months, you will receive five paid vacation days and three paid sick days.



Unused sick days will be paid out at the end of the applicable benefit year.



Vacation and sick time will renew annually based on your employment anniversary.



We want to respect the holidays that are important to you. When applying, please tell us which holidays you would normally like to take off with pay.



Holidays disclosed and approved in advance will generally be paid. You may request another important holiday later as long as you provide plenty of advance notice.



At the beginning of each year, you may confirm or change the holidays you expect to take during that year.



We do not currently have a fixed limit on holiday requests. However, if the total amount of requested paid holiday time becomes unusually high, we will discuss which days can remain paid and which additional days may need to be unpaid.



## How to Apply



Please answer the following questions honestly.



1. What is your name, city, and province?



2. Are you available to begin around the middle of October 2026?



3. Can you consistently work Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time?



4. Tell us about any work you have done involving telephone calls, customer service, scheduling, texting,
, or helping customers who were confused or upset. This experience does not need to come from an appliance repair company.



5. How comfortable are you answering incoming calls and making outgoing calls in English?



6. Are you currently working for another company or client? If so, what hours do you work?



7. How reliable are your internet and electricity? How frequently do you experience interruptions?



8. Do you currently have a backup option for electricity or internet? A backup is helpful, but it is not required.



9. Do you have a quiet place where you can answer customer calls professionally?



10. Which holidays would you normally like to take off with pay?



11. Are you comfortable with the guaranteed starting pay of $130 per week and the increase to a guaranteed $160 per week after 90 days?



12. Did you use AI to help write any part of your application? If so, please explain how you used it.



13. Include at least one paragraph written entirely in your own words. Place an asterisk at the beginning and end of that paragraph.



14. Why does this position interest you? What would you hope to learn or accomplish if you remained with Cityscape for a long time?



We are looking for someone dependable, honest, thoughtful, and interested in growing with a small business. If that sounds like you, we would be happy to review your application.

title: YouTube Channel Manager — Faceless Channels — Freelance, Remote
description:
I run a portfolio of faceless YouTube channels from the Netherlands with a remote team of scriptwriters, video editors and thumbnail artists. I'm looking for one person to become my right hand on the operational side.



Start date, hours and salary



Starting 1 October 2026. You begin at around 12 hours a week while you learn the channel and the pipeline. As you take on more — and as we add channels — that grows toward full-time, up to 40 hours a week. How fast depends on you. Pay is negotiable, and grows as your responsibilities do.



How this grows



You start with one channel — BloopUniverse, in the celebrity bloopers and compilations niche — and you run it end to end. Once it's running smoothly, we add a second channel built on AI scripts and voiceover. Then a third, and so on. The portfolio is expanding, and I need someone who grows with it rather than someone I have to replace when it does. Your rate goes up as the scope does.



So the first months are about BloopUniverse, done properly. The long game is that you manage several channels, each with its own team.



Working with AI is a requirement, not a bonus



Read this part carefully, because it's the core of the job.



For my other channels I've built AI agents that produce first drafts of scripts and thumbnail concepts. You paste in the title and references, and the agent gives you something back. That part is easy. What I'm hiring for is everything after: judging what came out, rewriting it, sharpening it, and rejecting it when it isn't good enough.



Daily work with Claude and ChatGPT is non-negotiable. If you're not already using these tools every day and getting real results out of them, this role isn't for you. But if you know why one prompt lands and another doesn't, and you can spot mediocre AI output in three seconds, you'll do well here.



Week to week



Brief and chase our scriptwriters, editors and thumbnail artists — deadlines, feedback, revisions

Upload and schedule: titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, end screens, playlists

Keep the content calendar current so nobody is waiting on anyone

Report weekly on views, CTR and retention — and tell me what you think it means

Write and publish community posts

Run the AI agents for scripts and thumbnails, then rewrite, sharpen and reject until the output is genuinely good (at a later stage)

And more — curious? Ask me for the full task list



I pick the topics. You own everything from there to published, with my input whenever you need it.



What I'm looking for



Creative judgment. You can read a script and know which joke doesn't land. You can look at a thumbnail and know why nobody would click it.

Strong communication skills — clear, prompt, and proactive

Experience managing and directing freelancers

Excellent written English — you'll be rewriting scripts, not proofreading them

Hands-on YouTube Studio experience

You fix things without being asked. If something in the pipeline is broken, I want your solution, not just the problem.

At least 4 hours of overlap with Central European Time

Daily, fluent use of Claude and ChatGPT (required — see above)



Nice to have



Experience with faceless or compilation channels

Experience coordinating freelancers

You find this stuff funny. If celebrity bloopers make you laugh, you'll be better at this than someone who doesn't care.



Terms



Freelance contractor, paid monthly. You invoice me; you handle your own taxes.

Rate is negotiable — tell me what you're looking for and we'll discuss it. I pay for judgment, not for hours logged.

Flexible hours. Deadlines matter, the clock doesn't.

Real ownership. You run the channel; I'm not looking over your shoulder daily.



How to apply



Start your application with the word BLOOPERS, followed by the best way to reach you directly. Anything without it gets deleted unread.



Then, briefly:



Tell me about a YouTube channel you've worked on and what you did. Link it if you can — if you can't share it, describe the channel and the numbers instead.

Pick any faceless compilation channel on YouTube. One thing they do well, one thing you'd change. Two sentences each.

Which AI tools do you use daily, and what for? Be specific.

Describe one time you used AI for creative work and the output wasn't good enough. What did you do?



Kind regards,

DIS Guido_20707

title: Civil / Structural Autocad Technician
description:
Structural CAD Technician / AutoCAD Drafter – Long-Term Remote Position



We are a UK-based structural surveying and engineering company looking for an experienced CAD technician to work with us on an ongoing basis.



This is not intended to be a one-off freelance role. We are looking for one reliable person who can learn our drawing standards, understand how we work and become our regular CAD resource.



The work:

- You will primarily produce 2D AutoCAD drawings of existing structures from information collected by our engineers during site surveys.



Typical projects include:



Reinforced concrete and steel-framed buildings

Masonry structures

Structural floor and roof layouts

Beams, columns, slabs and walls

Rooftop telecoms structures and equipment

Steel grillages, support frames and plinths

Towers and associated steelwork

Plans, elevations, sections and construction details



You will normally be provided with a combination of:



Engineer's site sketches

Dimensions and survey notes

Photographs

Marked-up PDFs

Existing drawings

Point-cloud or survey information where available

Our AutoCAD templates and drawing standards



You will convert this information into clear and accurate AutoCAD drawings for review by our UK engineers.



This is primarily a drafting role rather than a structural design role. Structural engineering decisions will remain with our engineers.



Requirements



You should have:



Strong AutoCAD 2D skills

Experience producing structural, civil or construction drawings

Good understanding of beams, columns, slabs, masonry and structural steelwork

Ability to interpret sketches, photographs and engineer mark-ups

Excellent attention to dimensions and drawing accuracy

Good written and spoken English

Reliable internet connection

Ability to work independently and ask questions when information is unclear



Experience with Revit and UK engineering drawings would be useful but is not essential.



Very important:



We do not expect you to guess missing engineering information.



If information is unclear, inconsistent or missing, we expect you to identify it and ask the engineer before proceeding.



Working arrangement:



Initially approximately 10-15 hours per week, with the opportunity for substantially more regular work if the arrangement is successful.



Working hours can be flexible. Some overlap with UK working hours is useful but not essential.



We are looking for a long-term working relationship, not simply the cheapest freelancer.



Pay:



US$6–9/hour initially depending on experience and ability.



There will be a paid CAD assessment for shortlisted candidates.



To apply, please send:



- A brief introduction and your relevant experience.

- Your CV

- 3–5 examples of structural/civil/construction AutoCAD drawings that you personally produced. These may be redacted if necessary

- Your hourly rate

- How many hours per week you are available

- Which version of AutoCAD you use

- A short explanation of what you would do if dimensions on an engineer's sketch conflicted with information visible in a site photograph



Please also tell us specifically what part of the drawings in your portfolio you produced yourself.



We are particularly interested in candidates who want stable, ongoing work and are willing to learn and consistently follow our company's CAD standards.

title: Business Research Analyst
description:
About the role

We are seeking a researcher to help the CEO make informed decisions across Cadothy’s AI companion robots and all-in-one live streaming studios, as well as our preschool business. You will investigate competitors, identify unmet customer needs, track relevant policies, and evaluate locations and businesses for potential expansion or acquisition, with an initial focus on Texas and selected other US states.

You will turn business questions into structured research, verify evidence, analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and explain what the findings mean for our next steps. Preschool research is a major part of this role. Priorities and deadlines will be agreed with the CEO.



Key responsibilities

Competitor and customer research

• Build and maintain competitor comparisons covering products or services, pricing, target customers, positioning, strengths, weaknesses, and customer experience. For preschools, compare tuition, programs, age groups, hours, locations, and enrollment or waitlist information where available.

• Analyze reviews, community discussions, and available customer feedback to identify recurring praise, complaints, unmet needs, and opportunities to improve our offerings. Group findings into consistent themes and explain the limitations of the sample.

Policy and regulatory research

• Monitor relevant state, local, and federal policies, including preschool licensing, staffing requirements, funding programs, and business incentives, as well as policies affecting our technology products. Use original government sources, record jurisdiction and effective dates, and distinguish proposals from rules in force.

• Summarize potential operational or growth implications, eligibility conditions, and questions requiring specialist verification.

Expansion and acquisition research

• Compare potential preschool markets and locations using factors such as families with young children, household income, population trends, competition, tuition, property costs, and available workforce or licensing information.

• Find businesses offered for sale and maintain a shortlist with location, asking price, reported financials, capacity or enrollment where available, property or lease details, and fit with our criteria. Label seller claims and missing information clearly; identify questions for further due diligence.

Research execution and recommendations

• Define the research question, scope, methods, sources, and comparison criteria before collecting information. Combine online research with databases, publications, public records, and approved interviews or inquiries when needed.

• Clean and organize data, perform basic statistical analysis, and prepare concise reports with findings, supporting evidence, business implications, options, and recommended next steps. Maintain an organized, searchable research archive and protect confidential information.

 

Required qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in a research-oriented discipline such as statistics, economics, business, public policy, education, psychology, or social sciences, or equivalent demonstrated research training and experience.

• Demonstrated experience completing structured research projects, preferably at least two years in business research, market research, policy analysis, or a comparable role. Substantial graduate research experience may also qualify when supported by relevant work samples.

• Ability to translate an open-ended business question into a practical research plan, assess source credibility, cross-check conflicting information, and separate verified facts, estimates, assumptions, and recommendations.

• Working knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methods, including thematic coding, sampling limitations, data cleaning, and basic descriptive statistics such as counts, percentages, means, medians, ranges, and trends.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, and comparable data tables. Ability to document sample sizes, denominators, missing data, and the basis for comparisons.

• Ability to use AI tools to assist with research planning, discovery, extraction, and synthesis, while checking material claims against original sources and reviewing calculations independently.

• Strong written English and clear business writing. Able to summarize complex findings concisely, explain uncertainty, work independently, and manage competing deadlines.



Preferred qualifications

• Master’s degree, PhD, or substantial postgraduate research training in a relevant discipline. Candidates with university research, thesis, dissertation, or research assistant experience are encouraged to apply.

• Formal coursework or practical experience in statistics, applied research methods, survey design, or quantitative analysis. Familiarity with Python, R, SPSS, SQL, or a comparable analysis tool is a plus.

• Experience researching US preschool or childcare markets, consumer technology, state policies, site selection, or small-business acquisitions. Familiarity with Texas markets is helpful.



Expected deliverables

• Competitor and customer insight trackers with comparable fields, source links, dates checked, review themes, and clearly identified information gaps.

• Policy briefs and location or acquisition shortlists explaining relevance, screening criteria, evidence, key assumptions, and follow-up questions.

• A concise executive brief for each major assignment, supported by organized data and reproducible calculations where applicable. Include the research question, method, main findings, limitations, business implications, and recommended next steps.

Success will be assessed through source accuracy, sound methods, clear analysis, timely delivery, and usefulness for decisions. Project scope and reporting frequency will reflect agreed working hours and research complexity.

Industry: Restaurant Technology / Point-of-Sale / Payments / SaaS

title: Senior LinkedIn Appointment Setter | Replies & Booking Only | Full Time 8h/day | up to $1,700/mo
description:
Hello ! We are an AI video production company scaling two founder LinkedIn accounts, and we are looking for an experienced salesperson to run those conversations full time.



The leads are already there. The replies land in the inbox every single day. What is missing is the person who answers them properly, qualifies them, and books the call.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION, AND IT IS NOT A VA ROLE. A SALES BACKGROUND IS REQUIRED. We are hiring a salesperson or a seasoned appointment setter, not a virtual assistant. No prospecting, no list building, no scraping. Conversations only, handled by a professional who already knows how to sell.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day, full time.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls enter the system over time, and after that, managing other setters. For the right person that is a real opportunity to grow inside the company, under a revised agreement.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 150 to 180 per day across both accounts

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Work the reactivation pool: warm leads who did not convert the first time

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. A real sales background. Non-negotiable.



Minimum 2 years in sales or appointment setting: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



We will not consider applications from general virtual assistants with no sales track record.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full-time dedication



This is a full-time role, 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday, structured as a morning block, a one-hour break, and an afternoon block. From time to time, one to three hours of Saturday work may be requested when campaign activity requires it, agreed in advance. Your daily window is fixed and agreed at interview, and it stays fixed once agreed.



During working hours you are dedicated exclusively to us, with no other job or client at the same time.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Hungry. Someone who wants to book calls and earn from them, not someone who wants to complete tasks.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract, paid every two weeks by bank transfer in USD

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term, full-time role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market, with a clear path towards running qualification calls and then managing setters



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.



>> COMPENSATION



- Base: $1,150 USD per month, full time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday

- Plus 3% commission on sales generated from the calls you book, paid when the client pays. Our programs sell between $2,500 and $10,000, so one single closed sale adds $75 to $300 to your month.

- Plus a $6 USD bonus for every qualified call you book that goes through the first call and progresses to a closing call. This rewards quality, not just volume.

- Realistic total at full speed: $1,300 to $1,700 per month.

- Paid every two weeks by bank transfer in USD.



This is deliberately top-of-market pay for this role in the Philippines. We want to be the job you prioritize, and we want someone who stays and grows with us.



>> HOW TO APPLY IN WRITING



Your application has two parts. Part one is written. Part two is a short video.

Both are required for the application to be complete.





1. Start your application with the word "MANGO" in capital letters. It simply tells us you read the post. Otherwise your application will not be taken into account in our system.



2. Answer these two questions in your own words:



Question 1: Look at 
 .

In 3 to 5 sentences, in your own words: what do you think we help people do?



Question 2: A prospect has told you twice that our program looks interesting. On your third message you ask to book a 15-minute call. He replies: "Honestly I'm fully booked until next month, let's talk then." Write the exact message you would send back, word for word, as you would really send it. One message only.



3. Your experience, in short and precise points:



- How many years in sales and in appointment setting, and for which companies or clients

- How many of those years on LinkedIn specifically

- What offers you were setting for, and at what price point

- Which outreach or conversational tools you have used

- How many messages you were sending per day at your busiest

- How many conversations you were handling at the same time at your busiest

- Your internet setup and your power backup plan, in one or two lines

- Every job, client or commitment you currently have, with the hours. Write "None" if you have none.

- One line confirming you understand this role is conversational: no lead generation, no scraping, no list building



4. Attach three documents:



- Your CV

- A Speedtest screenshot, taken where you will usually work

- A photo of your workstation, taken with your phone





>> WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application, your video and your attachments.

2. Selected candidates have a 30-minute video call with the founders.

3. We ask for one previous employer contact for a reference call.

4. Shortlisted candidates start with a one-week onboarding, followed by a one-week trial on real conversations.

title: Conversational DM Setter | You Reply, You Qualify, You Book | Part-Time 4h/day
description:
We are looking for a senior LinkedIn appointment setter to join one of the most exciting companies in the AI video production industry. If you are experienced, sharp, and you love turning conversations into booked calls, keep reading, this could be the role you have been waiting for.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION. We are looking for an experienced, seasoned LinkedIn appointment setter.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls may enter the system over time, and for the right person that is a real opportunity to grow.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 100 per account per day, roughly 200 per day in total

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. Experience: minimum 2 years appointment setting, minimum 1 year on LinkedIn specifically



Two years minimum in appointment setting, with at least one of those years in LinkedIn DM setting specifically: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full dedication during working hours



We are looking for someone fully dedicated to the company during their working hours, with no other job at the same time. Those hours may increase over time as the role grows.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.



>> COMPENSATION



- Base: $550 USD per month, around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday

- Plus 3% commission on sales generated from the calls you book, paid when the client pays. Our programs sell between $2,500 and $10,000, so one single closed sale adds $75 to $300 to your month.

- Realistic total at full speed: $625 to $850 per month. For a 4-hour role, that is top-of-market pay in the Philippines, and it is deliberate. We want to be the job you prioritize.



Hours: around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday. Monday to Friday is your main setting time, and Saturday is a shorter one focused on reactivation messages. Your daily hours sit in a fixed window, morning or afternoon Philippine time, agreed at interview based on the team's coverage needs and your availability, and they stay fixed once agreed.



>> HOW TO APPLY



Your application has two parts. Part one is written. Part two is a short video. 

Both are required for the application to be complete.



PART ONE, IN WRITING



1. Start your application with the word "MANGO" in capital letters. It simply tells us you read the post. Otherwise your application will not be taken into account in our system.



2. Answer these two questions in your own words:



Question 1: Look at 
. 

In 3 to 5 sentences, in your own words: what do you think we help people do?



Question 2: A prospect has told you twice that our program looks interesting. On your third message you ask to book a 15-minute call. He replies: "Honestly I'm fully booked until next month, let's talk then." Write the exact message you would send back, word for word, as you would really send it. One message only.



3. Your experience, in short and precise points:



- How many years of appointment setting, and for which companies or clients

- How many of those years on LinkedIn specifically

- What offers you were setting for, and at what price point

- Which outreach or conversational tools you have used

- How many messages you were sending per day at your busiest

- How many conversations you were handling at the same time at your busiest

- Your internet setup and your power backup plan, in one or two lines

- Every job, client or commitment you currently have, with the hours. Write "None" if you have none.

- One line confirming you understand this role is conversational: no lead generation, no scraping, no list building



4. Attach three documents:



- Your CV

- A Speedtest screenshot, taken where you will usually work

- A photo of your workstation, taken with your phone



PART TWO, THE VIDEO



Record a video of yourself, 1 to 2 minutes, face on camera. Keep it simple and natural:



- Introduce yourself: who you are, your hobbies, what you enjoy doing

- Tell us about your appointment setting experience in your own words



You can record it with a free tool like Loom (
): it records you from your browser and gives you a link to paste into your application. Any similar tool works, as long as we can see and hear you clearly.



We use this video for two things: your spoken English and your personality. We are looking for someone engaging, with energy. No script needed, just talk to us.



>> WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application, your video and your attachments.

2. Selected candidates have a 30-minute video call with the founders.

3. We ask for one previous employer contact for a reference call.

4. Shortlisted candidates start with a one-week onboarding, followed by a one-week trial on real conversations.



>> AUTOMATIC REJECTION



X No presentation video

X No photo of the workstation

X No Speedtest screenshot

X The application does not start with MANGO

X Less than 2 years appointment setting experience

X Applications pitching lead generation, scraping or research services

X Generic, copy-pasted or AI-written text with nothing personal in it

X An unclear situation regarding other jobs and clients



>> A FINAL WORD



We are looking for a strong candidate who wants to grow inside the company. Xtendency.ai has a serious work ethic and a kind, professional environment, and this is a key role in it: a professional we can rely on completely, pay properly, and grow with as the company scales.



What matters most to us: honesty, discipline, consistency, fast learning, and a real human understanding of people. The offer and the scripts, we will train you on.



If that is you, apply carefully and completely. We will be very happy to meet you.



Xtendency.ai

title: Creative Production Assistant / Junior Graphic Designer
description:
I'm looking for a creative and organised person to join me in growing an e-commerce apparel brand.



I've built and run the business myself so far and currently handle almost all of the creative work, including T-shirt designs, product mock-ups, advertising graphics and
 creative.



The business is growing, and I've reached the point where I'm looking for someone who can work alongside me, initially helping with creative production, but with the opportunity to take on considerably more creative responsibility over time.



What you'll initially be doing



Your main responsibility at first will be taking finished T-shirt designs and preparing them for sale. This will include:



Creating product mock-ups using Photoshop/Photopea templates

Checking artwork sizing, positioning and overall presentation

Preparing and exporting image files correctly

Following established workflows and processes

Performing visual quality checks before products are published

Preparing posts for social media



Having a good eye is important. I'm not looking for someone who simply follows instructions and clicks buttons. If a design looks too large, too small, poorly positioned or simply doesn't look right on the shirt, I'd like you to notice it and make sensible decisions.



Where the role can grow



For the right person, I want this role to become much more than the tasks above.



Over time, I'd like you to become involved with:



Creating graphics and creatives for Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising

Producing variations of successful advertising creatives

Creating graphics and layouts for
 campaigns

Adapting existing T-shirt designs and concepts

Researching creative ideas and trends

Helping develop new creative concepts

Eventually creating original apparel designs from briefs



The long-term goal is to find someone who understands the visual identity of the brand extremely well and can become a trusted creative member of the business as it grows.



About you:



You don't necessarily need years of professional experience or a huge portfolio.



I'm more interested in finding someone who:



Has strong visual judgement and enjoys design

Is comfortable with Photoshop and/or Photopea

Understands layers, smart objects, masks and image exporting

Has excellent attention to detail

Is organised and reliable

Can follow a process but also think for themselves

Communicates clearly

Is curious and enjoys learning new things

Is comfortable learning new software and workflows

Takes ownership and notices problems rather than waiting to be told about everything



Bonus skills — definitely not required



You don't need to have all (or even any) of these, but I'd be particularly interested to hear if you have experience or an interest in:



Video editing and creating short-form video content

Modern AI tools and creative platforms

Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising creatives

 design or platforms such as Klaviyo

Shopify or other e-commerce platforms

Apparel/T-shirt design

Illustrator, Canva or other creative software

Social media content creation

Photography or image editing



Please don't be put off applying if you don't have experience in these areas. I'm much more interested in creativity, attention to detail, curiosity and willingness to learn. There will be plenty of opportunity to develop new skills as the role grows.



I personally enjoy experimenting with technology, AI and automation to remove repetitive work from the business, so someone who is interested in new creative tools and finding better ways of working would fit in particularly well.



What working with me will look like



You'll initially work closely with me, the founder and current designer. I'll provide templates, examples and processes and help you understand exactly how I like things done.



As you become familiar with the brand, I'd like you to take increasing ownership of the production process so that I can concentrate more heavily on creating new designs and growing the business.



I'm also actively building systems and automation around repetitive parts of the business. The intention isn't for you to spend forever doing repetitive production work. As we improve those systems, I'd like your role to increasingly move towards more interesting and creative work.



I'm looking for someone interested in a long-term role and grow with the business.



To apply, please include:



A short introduction about yourself

Examples of your creative/design work or a portfolio (this doesn't need to be professional client work)

The design software you're most comfortable using

Any experience you have with the bonus skills above

Your current availability and preferred number of hours per week

Your expected hourly rate

A piece of creative work you're particularly proud of and why



Shortlisted applicants will have a relaxed video chat with me followed by a small paid practical task. This isn't intended to be a long unpaid design exercise. I simply want to see how you approach real examples of the work we'd be doing together.



If you're creative, dependable, curious and excited about learning new things, I'd be very happy to hear from you.

title: Xactimate Estimator - Scope Sheet Reviewer (Water Mitigation, US Eastern Hours)
description:
Restoration Doctor is a water, fire, mold and sewage damage restoration company in Northern Virginia, Maryland and Washington, D.C. Every job ends in a scope sheet: Xactimate line items, room measurements, equipment days and labor hours that become the estimate a carrier pays against. The owner checks every sheet himself today. We are hiring two experienced Xactimate estimators to take that review over, and the first two people in the seat will lead the review team as it grows.



THE WORK

You review scope sheets that our project managers submit through our dashboard, before they are approved. For each sheet you:

- Confirm every room name and dimension against the Matterport 3D scan (floor SF, wall SF, ceiling SF, flooring SY, perimeter LF).

- Verify equipment counts and unit-days from the CompanyCam photo record. The photographed count sheet wins.

- Verify supervisory hours from the first and last photo of each day on site.

- Check every line item's unit and quantity against the measured room: flood cuts in LF, tear-outs in SF, antimicrobial on the treated surface.

- Open the evidence photo on every confirmed line and d
 if it shows the billed work.

- Catch what is missing (PPE, decontamination, antimicrobial, hauling, final cleaning) and what is billed twice.

- Approve, or send the sheet back with a written note the project manager can act on line by line.

Volume today is five to ten sheets a week across the team, and it grows with the team. A full review takes three to five hours.



YOU NEED

- 2+ years writing or reviewing Xactimate estimates for US water mitigation work. Level 2 or higher is a plus.



- Working knowledge of IICRC S500 drying principles and loss categories. 



- Comfort reading 3D scans and floor plans, and working from photo timestamps.



- Fluent written English. You will write to project managers and, at times, to adjusters.



- Reliable availability 8:00 am to 5:00 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday (8:00 pm to 5:00 am Manila during US daylight time, one hour later from November to March).



- Your own computer with two screens, a stable 25 Mbps or better connection, and a quiet workspace.

A plus: IICRC WRT, hands-on time with CompanyCam, Matterport, Encircle or DocuSketch, TPA or insurance claims review experience.



This role is not for you if you do not have at least 24 months of expereice writing interior water damage/mold estimates from scratch. This role will sometimes have you check someone else's, or if you are uncomfortable constantly staying in communication with on site project managers and possibly telling a project manager in writing that a line is wrong or needs changing this role is not for you.



PAY AND TERMS

- Full rate: $1,700 to $2,000 USD per month for 40 paid hours a week, set by experience. Five or more years of Xactimate work places you at the top of the range. The figure includes a 10 percent night differential for US hours.

- Training month (days 1 to 30): 80 percent of your agreed full rate ($1,360 to $1,600). You review alongside the owner on live sheets and closed jobs. You move to the full rate on day 31 when your last ten reviews match the owner's decision on at least nine. The step-up date goes in your contract. If you fall short, the engagement ends.

- 13th month pay, paid in December (pro-rated in year one).

- Paid Philippine regular holidays after 90 days. HMO allowance of $35/month after 90 days. Internet allowance of $30/month from day one.

- Paid every two weeks in USD through Wise.

- We provide and pay for all logins: our dashboard, CompanyCam and Matterport. The review runs in our custom dashboard, so you do not need your own Xactimate seat.

- Independent contractor, month to month, renewed on performance.

- Start as soon as you are hired. Applications close October 28th, 2026.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here, then
 
 with the subject line: 

Scope Sheet Reviewer: [Your Name]. 



Include:

1. Your resume.

2. A short summary of your Xactimate experience: years, certification level, loss types, and the US companies you have worked with.

3. Top 10 estimates you wrote or reviewed, with customer details removed. 

4. A screenshot of an internet speed test from your workspace.

5. Your confirmation that you can train from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm US Eastern, Monday to Friday.

Start your
 with the word PERIMETER so we know you read this far.



What happens next: we reply within three business days, then a 20-minute video call with the owner, then a paid sample review of one real closed job ($50 through Wise, whatever the outcome), then an offer and a written agreement. 



Shortlisted candidates receive our full nine-page position brief as a PDF.



Restoration Doctor | 
 | Virginia, Maryland, Washington D.C, Florida, New York



 Xactimate, Water Damage Restoration, Insurance Estimating, Matterport, CompanyCam, IICRC S500, Quality Assurance, Document Review.
