title: Senior LinkedIn Appointment Setter | Replies & Booking Only | 4h/day | up to $760/mo
description:
We are looking for a rockstar LinkedIn appointment setter to join one of the most exciting companies in the AI video production industry. If you are experienced, sharp, and you love turning conversations into booked calls, keep reading, this could be the role you have been waiting for.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION. We are looking for an experienced, seasoned LinkedIn appointment setter.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls may enter the system over time, and for the right person that is a real opportunity to grow.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 100 per account per day, roughly 200 per day in total

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. Experience: minimum 2 years appointment setting, minimum 1 year on LinkedIn specifically



Two years minimum in appointment setting, with at least one of those years in LinkedIn DM setting specifically: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full dedication during working hours



We are looking for someone fully dedicated to the company during their working hours, with no other job at the same time. Those hours may increase over time as the role grows.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.



>> COMPENSATION



- Base: $550 USD per month, around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday

- Plus 3% commission on sales generated from the calls you book, paid when the client pays. Our programs sell between $2,500 and $10,000, so one single closed sale adds $75 to $300 to your month.

- Realistic total at full speed: $625 to $850 per month. For a 4-hour role, that is top-of-market pay in the Philippines, and it is deliberate. We want to be the job you prioritize.



Hours: around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday. Monday to Friday is your main setting time, and Saturday is a shorter one focused on reactivation messages. Your daily hours sit in a fixed window, morning or afternoon Philippine time, agreed at interview based on the team's coverage needs and your availability, and they stay fixed once agreed.



>> HOW TO APPLY



Your application has two parts. Part one is written. Part two is a short video. 

Both are required for the application to be complete.



PART ONE, IN WRITING



1. Start your application with the word "MANGO" in capital letters. It simply tells us you read the post. Otherwise your application will not be taken into account in our system.



2. Answer these two questions in your own words:



Question 1: Look at 
. 

In 3 to 5 sentences, in your own words: what do you think we help people do?



Question 2: A prospect has told you twice that our program looks interesting. On your third message you ask to book a 15-minute call. He replies: "Honestly I'm fully booked until next month, let's talk then." Write the exact message you would send back, word for word, as you would really send it. One message only.



3. Your experience, in short and precise points:



- How many years of appointment setting, and for which companies or clients

- How many of those years on LinkedIn specifically

- What offers you were setting for, and at what price point

- Which outreach or conversational tools you have used

- How many messages you were sending per day at your busiest

- Every job, client or commitment you currently have, with the hours. Write "None" if you have none.

- One line confirming you understand this role is conversational: no lead generation, no scraping, no list building



4. Attach three documents:



- Your CV

- A Speedtest screenshot, taken where you will usually work

- A photo of your workstation, taken with your phone



PART TWO, THE VIDEO



Record a video of yourself, 1 to 2 minutes, face on camera. Keep it simple and natural:

- Tell us about your appointment setting experience in your own words



You can record it with a free tool like Loom (
): it records you from your browser and gives you a link to paste into your application. Any similar tool works, as long as we can see and hear you clearly.



We use this video for two things: your spoken English and your personality. We are looking for someone engaging, with energy. No script needed, just talk to us.



>> WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application, your video and your attachments.

2. Selected candidates have a 30-minute video call with the founders.

3. We ask for one previous employer contact for a reference call.

4. Shortlisted candidates start with a one-week onboarding, followed by a one-week trial on real conversations.



>> AUTOMATIC REJECTION



X No presentation video

X No Speedtest screenshot

X The application does not start with MANGO

X Less than 2 years appointment setting experience

X Applications pitching lead generation, scraping or research services

X Generic, copy-pasted or AI-written text with nothing personal in it

X An unclear situation regarding other jobs and clients



>> A FINAL WORD



We are looking for a strong candidate who wants to grow inside the company. Xtendency.ai has a serious work ethic and a kind, professional environment, and this is a key role in it: a professional we can rely on completely, pay properly, and grow with as the company scales.



What matters most to us: honesty, discipline, consistency, fast learning, and a real human understanding of people. The offer and the scripts, we will train you on.



If that is you, apply carefully and completely. We will be very happy to meet you.



Xtendency.ai

rsonal Care experience is core to this role, every applicant we approve and invite to an interview will be required to take a live proctored exam to evaluate their WellSky knowledge as part of the hiring process.

title: Finance Manager / Financial Controller for a UK company
description:
A CFO overseeing a portfolio of fast-growing, product-based and retail brands across the UK is looking to build up the capability of the finance function properly, not just keep it running as is.



Right now, the CFO handles the bulk of the accounting personally, bookkeeping through to forecasting, across every business in the portfolio. We're hiring a Financial Controller to take full ownership of that function and build it into something stronger, working closely with the CFO throughout rather than inheriting it in isolation.



This is a senior, hands-on role built around real ownership, not a narrow, single-client bookkeeping job. The portfolio is kept deliberately focused, so the role is about doing the work well, not managing volume.



Because the businesses in the portfolio vary in size, sector and complexity, the scope of this role will shift as needs change. You'll need to be comfortable adapting to what each client requires rather than working from a fixed, unchanging list of tasks.



Important



This role isn't suited to someone who wants to keep their head down and do the basics. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of problems from discovery through to resolution, who questions how things are done and pushes for a better way when something doesn't add up, and who can hold a confident, informed conversation with the CFO about the numbers.



This is not a client-facing role. The CFO keeps direct client relationships and calls; your focus is on building and running the finance function itself.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Financial Reporting & Accounting

- Month-end close and management reporting across multiple client accounts

- Maintaining accurate financial records and reconciliations

- Supporting year-end accounting



Inventory & Operational Finance

- Inventory and landed cost accounting

- Retail deductions and operational finance support

- Managing and reconciling large datasets across multiple systems



Forecasting & Analysis

- Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts and cash flow projections

- Investigating and resolving discrepancies and variances independently

- Ad hoc financial and operational analysis



Process & Relationship Ownership

- Improving finance processes and workflows across the portfolio

- Running the day-to-day finance function with minimal oversight

- Bringing issues and improvement ideas to the CFO with confidence, not just waiting to be asked



What We're Looking For

- Genuinely proactive: you notice when something doesn't add up or a process doesn't make sense, and you push to fix it rather than working around it

- Proven experience running a finance function independently, not just contributing to one within a larger team

- Experience managing the finance function across multiple client accounts or entities at once, comfortable prioritising and moving between businesses of different sizes and complexity

- Genuine hands-on experience building management accounts and forecasts from scratch

- Comfortable producing forward-looking analysis and insight, not only reviewing and flagging issues in bookkeeping

- Experience with Amazon or e-commerce accounting operations and large transaction datasets

- Fluent in tools such as Xero, Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online and BI or reporting platforms

title: Full-Time Senior Escalations Specialist / Team Lead
description:
We are a digital media company running a portfolio of media channels. A remote team, content pipelines, and ongoing correspondence with US agencies that supply the source material our content is built on. The content is high-production.



We're looking for someone with strong experience handling difficult escalations, researching unfamiliar problems, and finding solutions independently.



The ideal person has worked in a role where complicated issues eventually landed on their desk because the normal process wasn't enough. You are expected to investigate what was happening, work through incomplete or conflicting information, figure out your options, and come back with a solution without needing a supervisor to tell you every next step.



This could come from experience in senior customer escalations, case management, investigations, claims, disputes, legal support, compliance, research-heavy operations, or another environment where you regularly had to solve problems on your own.



This is not a generic Virtual Assistant position. If most of your senior-level experience has been calendar management, inbox management, scheduling, routine administrative work, or coordinating tasks for executives, this won’t be the right fit.





What we're looking for



We want someone who is comfortable being the person a difficult problem gets handed to.



When something doesn't fit neatly into the normal process, your first instinct shouldn't be to immediately ask a supervisor what to do. We expect you to investigate the issue, use the resources available to you, understand the problem, and work toward a solution.



That can mean:



- Researching an unfamiliar rule, policy, law, or process

- Using Claude, Google, and other resources to work through complicated questions

- Looking at information from multiple sources and figuring out what matters

- Writing a strong response after researching an issue

- Finding alternatives when the obvious solution is too expensive or impractical

- Figuring out how something can be narrowed or adjusted without losing what we actually need

- Working through cases where the information is incomplete, unclear, or doesn't fit neatly into an SOP

- Taking over issues that someone else has already tried to solve and figuring out what should happen next



The core trait we're looking for is a mix of resourcefulness + problem-solving.



We want someone who doesn't get intimidated when a straightforward task turns into a messy one. Someone who is willing to dig into the details, do the grunt work, research what they don't know, and keep working the problem until they understand it.





How the role starts



You will start by learning the normal day-to-day work of the team and handling cases yourself.



This is intentional.



To eventually solve difficult tickets for other people, you need firsthand experience with the work they're doing. You need to understand the processes, communications, records, common problems, and where things tend to get stuck.



The goal is not to keep the right person doing routine work indefinitely.



We're specifically looking for someone who can absorb the process quickly and develop into a ticket solver / lead who can take over the more difficult issues the rest of the team can't resolve independently.



That progression will depend on your ability to demonstrate that you can learn quickly, retain what you learn, research independently, make good judgment calls, and consistently find solutions.





You may be a strong fit if you:



- Have previously owned difficult escalations or complex cases

- Have been trusted to solve problems without immediately involving a supervisor

- Learn new systems and processes quickly

- Retain what you learn and apply it to new situations

- Are comfortable researching things you've never encountered before

- Can work through a problem even when there isn't a clear SOP for it

- Know how to use AI tools as part of your research without blindly accepting their answers

- Can read through a lot of information and identify what's relevant

- Communicate clearly and can write a strong, well-researched response

- Are comfortable making reasonable judgment calls once you've gathered enough information

- Aren't afraid of tedious research or grunt work

- Want to become genuinely excellent at a specialized type of work



We care much less about your job title than what you were actually responsible for.





Compensation



- Base compensation of **$1,100-$1,600 USD per month for 160 hours**

- Final offer will depend on experience, communication skills, and overall fit

- Performance bonuses may be awarded when agreed milestones and performance targets are met





HOW TO APPLY



Please send your application to 
 with the subject line “Doventra Senior Escalations Specialist -  Your Full Name"



Include:



1. Your full name

2. Your earliest possible full-time start date

3. Your written English rating from 1-10 (please don’t put 10 if you heavily rely on AI to write EVERYTHING for you)

4. Your spoken English rating from 1-10

5. A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile

6. A link to your LinkedIn profile

7. A link to your
 profile

8. Confirmation that you can commit exclusively to this role and will not work with other full-time or part-time clients or employers while employed with us (this is a full-time, long-term position. We use time tracking and require team members to work exclusively with us during their scheduled working hours).

9. Confirmation that you are comfortable using Hubstaff

10. Confirmation that you are willing to sign an NDA and complete identity verification



Then answer the questions below:



**1. Tell us about one of the most difficult problems or escalations you personally owned in a previous job.**



Choose an example where there wasn't an obvious answer and you couldn't simply follow the usual process.



What was the problem? What did you personally investigate or try? How did you d
 what to do? What was the final result? Explain in detail.



**2. You're given a task that normally has a straightforward process, but halfway through you realize the usual process won't work in this particular situation. You've never encountered the issue before and your manager is unavailable.**



Walk us through what you would do next.



Be specific about what you would investigate, what resources you would use, and how you would d
 whether you had enough information to move forward.



**3. An agency tells you that fulfilling a request will cost more than the usual range because the request is too broad. Paying the full amount is not a reasonable option, but we still need useful records from the request. You don't yet know exactly what is driving the cost.**



Walk us through what you would do next.



Be specific about what you would investigate, what questions you would ask, what alternatives you would consider, and how you would d
 whether the request could be narrowed without losing what we actually need.



**4. Someone gives you a reason why something cannot be done and refers to a rule, policy, or requirement you've never encountered before. You're not sure whether their interpretation is correct.**



You have access to Google, Claude, and other research tools.



Walk us through how you would research the issue, determine whether the explanation is correct, and d
 what to do next.



**5. When you run into a problem you genuinely cannot solve, how do you d
 that it's time to involve your manager?**



What would you want to have already done before bringing the problem to them?





Please answer every question yourself. We care much more about seeing how you think, research, and work through difficult situations than receiving perfectly polished answers. Generic or heavily AI-written answers will be rejected.

title: Automotive Parts Research Specialist – VIN / TecDoc / OEM Cross Reference
description:
## Automotive Parts Research Specialist – VIN / TecDoc / OEM Cross Reference



We are an automotive parts company looking for a reliable full-time remote team member to help our sales team identify the correct automotive parts quickly and accurately.



### Main Responsibilities



* Search automotive parts by VIN, vehicle details, engine code, and model

* Identify correct OEM / OE part numbers

* Find aftermarket alternatives and cross-reference part numbers

* Work with TecDoc and other automotive parts catalogs

* Compare part numbers between different suppliers and manufacturers

* Update product and supplier mappings in our ERP system

* Prepare information for our sales team so they can quote customers quickly

* Check unclear or difficult vehicle/part matches

* Keep records organized and accurate

* Report when there are multiple possible parts or when you are not 100% sure



### Very Important



Accuracy is more important than speed.



We do not want someone who guesses.



If there are two possible parts for a vehicle, you must clearly report that further verification is required.



### Experience We Prefer



Experience with any of the following is a big advantage:



* TecDoc

* OEM / OE automotive part numbers

* VIN lookup

* EPC systems

* Parts catalogues

* Bosch

* MANN

* MAHLE

* Denso

* Valeo

* VAG / ETKA

* BMW ETK

* Mercedes EPC

* Toyota / Hyundai / Kia / Japanese or European vehicle catalogues

* Automotive spare parts e-commerce or wholesale companies



### Work Style



This is not a customer service role.



You will mainly work as a back-office automotive parts research specialist supporting our sales team.



You must be:



* Very detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at researching difficult cases

* Able to follow procedures

* Comfortable using Excel / Google Sheets / ERP systems

* Honest when you are unsure about a part match



### Working Hours



Full-time preferred.



Working hours should overlap with Israel business hours for at least part of the day.



Israel time is UTC+2 / UTC+3 depending on daylight saving time.



### Salary



Starting salary: **USD $650–$800 per month**, depending on automotive parts experience and skill level.



Salary can increase after the probation period based on accuracy, productivity, reliability, and ability to work independently.



### Application Test



Please do not send a generic application.



In your application, answer these questions:



1. Have you worked with automotive spare parts before? Please explain.

2. Have you used TecDoc? For how long?

3. Which EPC or automotive catalog systems have you used?

4. Are you comfortable finding OE/OEM numbers using a VIN?

5. Which vehicle brands do you know best?

6. Give one example of how you would verify that a part definitely fits a specific vehicle.

7. What is your expected monthly salary?

8. Can you work full-time?

9. What hours can you work in Philippine time?



Please start your application with the words:



**PARTS RESEARCH**



Applications without these words may not be reviewed.



### Paid Trial



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid practical test involving real vehicle and part lookup cases.



We will measure:



* Accuracy

* Speed

* Ability to cross-reference parts

* Ability to identify uncertainty

* Quality of documentation



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our team.

title: Self-Storage Facility Lead Research VA (Real Estate Deal Sourcing)
description:
About us: Skip Rock Properties is a direct buyer of self-storage facilities -- not a brokerage. We buy off-market, value-add facilities directly from long-time owners, often with seller financing. Most of the facilities we want to buy aren't listed for sale anywhere -- they belong to owners who've run them quietly for decades with no website and no online listing. Finding those owners before anyone else does is the job.



What you'll do:

You'll build out our town-by-town lead list of self-storage facilities across target US states, working from smallest population up. For each town you will:



- Search for every self-storage facility within roughly a 6-8 mile radius of the town center -- not just what shows up on a basic Google Maps search, but everything actually there.

- Do a "flyover" -- visually scan satellite/aerial imagery (Google Maps satellite view, Google Earth) around the town for storage facilities that don't show up in a normal map search at all. These are usually older, family-owned lots with no signage and no online footprint. This is the single most valuable thing you'll do -- we call these "gold leads."

- Estimate the square footage of each facility's buildings from the aerial/satellite view.

- Score each facility's digital presence: Google Business listing (Y/N), website (Y/N), is the website actually functional, can customers pay/reserve online. Weak or no online presence is exactly what we're after -- it signals an owner who isn't actively marketing or managing the business.

- Identify the owner behind each facility using public records -- county appraisal district (property tax) records first, then state Secretary of State / business entity filings, then any other legitimate public source. We need owner name, LLC/entity name if any, mailing address, and ideally phone and
.

- Exclude corporate-owned facilities -- anything owned by a REIT, national/regional storage chain, or investment fund gets flagged and excluded.

- Log everything into our shared spreadsheet in the exact format we use, keeping the list sorted by town population and never overwriting existing rows.



This is ongoing work -- once a state's town list is worked through, we move to the next one.



What we're looking for:

- Sharp with Google Maps, Google Earth, and satellite/aerial imagery -- comfortable spotting a building from above and estimating its size

- Very comfortable in Google Sheets: sorting, formatting, careful data entry, following a strict column structure

- Patient and thorough with public records research (county property records, state business entity searches)

- Self-directed -- you'll get a clear process to follow and should work through it independently, flagging anything unclear rather than guessing

- Strong written English for documenting sources and notes clearly

- Meticulous -- if a piece of data isn't confirmed, mark it unconfirmed, don't leave it blank or make it up



Nice to have: prior experience with real estate lead generation, skip tracing, or VA work for a real estate investor; familiarity with county appraisal district / property tax websites; familiarity with self-storage or commercial real estate.



This is not a sales or cold-calling role -- outreach to owners is handled separately. Your job is finding the facilities and the people behind them, accurately and completely.



To apply: tell us about your experience with online research, Google Maps/Earth, and spreadsheets. If possible, pick any small Texas town and tell us what self-storage facilities you can find there in 30 minutes, including at least one attempt at a "flyover" find.

title: Virtual Assistant — Sales & Marketing Operations  Commercial Property Maintenance Company | Central Florida

We need someone who can multitask, move quickly, follow systems, communicate professionally, and prioritize revenue-producing activities.



You will work directly with the owner and help manage the day-to-day sales and marketing operations of the company.



The goal is simple:



Keep the bids moving. Keep leads and clients followed up with. Keep our marketing machine running.



I currently handle all of this myself and am significantly behind on bids because I am also responsible for sales, relationship building, marketing, and business development. I need someone who can take these operational responsibilities off my plate.

s/texts as directed

s.



Experience with Apollo.io, LinkedIn prospecting, cold

4. GOHIGHLEVEL, WEBSITE & MARKETING SYSTEMS — #4 PRIORITY



You will also help build and maintain our marketing infrastructure.



This includes:

You do need to be comfortable learning new software and figuring things out.

PHONE RESPONSIBILITIES



You will also answer incoming business calls.



You will:

* Identify what the caller needs

* Collect the appropriate information

* Route calls to the correct person

* Schedule calls/appointments when appropriate

* Take messages

* Follow up when necessary

* Make sure important calls are never missed



You will be representing a professional commercial services company, so excellent communication skills are required.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The right person is:



Highly organized

Extremely reliable

A fast learner

Tech-savvy

A strong communicator

Detail-oriented

Comfortable multitasking

Self-motivated

Good at following systems

Good at figuring things out independently



You need to be comfortable switching between multiple platforms throughout the day.



For example:



Bid comes in → enter bid → update CRM → follow up with property manager → answer phone → add prospects to Apollo → check cold
 campaign → build a GHL workflow → return to bids.



If that sounds overwhelming, this probably isn’t the right position.



If that sounds like a normal workday to you, we want to hear from you.



⸻



PRIORITY ORDER



Your priorities will be:

Our goal is 4+ bids per day.



#2 — FOLLOW-UP

#3 — OUTBOUND MARKETING



Apollo, LinkedIn, cold

Preferred Experience

 domain setup

⸻



THE BIGGEST THING WE CARE ABOUT

This position will start with clearly defined responsibilities and processes. As you learn the business, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and become an important part of the company’s operations.

title: Medical Biller
description:
Experienced Medical Biller – Outpatient PT/OT/ST



Location: Remote

Employment Type: Part-Time / Full-Time

Industry: Outpatient Rehabilitation / Therapy Services



We are looking for an experienced Medical Biller to join our team and manage billing and claims for an outpatient therapy practice providing Physical Therapy (PT), Occupational Therapy (OT), and Speech Therapy (ST) services.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with outpatient therapy billing, understands the complexities of insurance claims, and is knowledgeable about payer-specific requirements. Experience working with Pennsylvania and Ohio Medicare/Medicaid and commercial insurance plans is highly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

Submit and manage claims for PT, OT, and ST services

Verify patient eligibility, benefits, authorizations, and coverage requirements

Review claims for accuracy, including CPT/HCPCS codes, modifiers, diagnosis codes, units, and timely filing requirements

Follow up on unpaid, denied, rejected, and underpaid claims

Investigate denials and determine appropriate corrections, appeals, or resubmissions

Post insurance payments and reconcile EOBs/ERAs

Identify and resolve billing and reimbursement issues

Maintain accurate billing records and follow up on outstanding accounts

Communicate with insurance companies regarding claims, authorizations, benefits, and payment issues

Stay current with payer policies, billing guidelines, and regulatory requirements affecting outpatient therapy services

Identify billing trends and recurring denial issues and recommend appropriate solutions

Required Qualifications

3+ years of medical billing experience, preferably in an outpatient therapy or rehabilitation setting

Direct experience billing Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Physical Therapy

Strong knowledge of CPT/HCPCS coding, modifiers, diagnosis coding, units, and therapy-specific billing requirements

Experience with insurance eligibility, authorizations, claims, denials, appeals, and payment posting

Strong understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance billing

Excellent attention to detail and ability to independently research and resolve claim issues

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines

Strongly Preferred

Experience billing Pennsylvania and Ohio Medicare/Medicaid and commercial insurance plans

Knowledge of Pennsylvania- and Ohio-specific insurance requirements, regulations, and guidelines affecting outpatient PT/OT/ST services

Familiarity with payers such as Highmark, UPMC, Aetna, Capital Blue Cross, GHP Family, AmeriHealth Caritas, and other Pennsylvania and Ohio insurance plans

Experience using Availity and other payer portals

Experience with electronic claims submission and ERA/EOB reconciliation

Experience working with SimplePractice or similar EHR/practice management systems

What We’re Looking For



We are looking for someone who is more than just a claims processor. The ideal candidate should be able to understand why a claim is not paying, research the payer’s requirements, identify the underlying issue, and determine the appropriate solution.



Strong knowledge of outpatient PT/OT/ST billing and Pennsylvania and Ohio payer requirements is especially important for this position.



To Apply



Please submit your resume and briefly describe:



Your experience with PT/OT/ST billing

The insurance plans and payers you have worked with

Your experience with Pennsylvania and Ohio Medicare/Medicaid

Your experience with Pennsylvania and Ohio commercial insurance plans

The billing/EHR and payer portal systems you have used



Interested applicants may send their applications to

title: Long-Term YouTube Video Editor — AI Visuals, Consistent Characters & Storytelling
description:
LONG-TERM YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR — AI VISUALS, CONSISTENT CHARACTERS & STORYTELLING



I am looking for a talented and reliable long-term video editor to help produce story-led English-learning YouTube videos.



This is not a simple cutting/editing role.



I need someone who can take a completed script, finished voiceover, approved recurring-character reference images and clear creative direction, and turn them into a polished 20–30 minute YouTube video.



The videos are based around realistic workplace stories, international careers and professional English.



I WILL PROVIDE:



• Final script

• Finished voiceover/audio

• Approved recurring-character reference images

• Visual and creative direction

• Episode-specific notes

• Examples of the quality and style required



YOUR ROLE:



You will be responsible for creating the complete visual production and edit.



This includes:



• Planning the visuals from the script

• Creating original AI-generated images where appropriate

• Maintaining the same recurring characters consistently across scenes

• Using AI-assisted video or movement where useful

• Using commercially licensed stock selectively for generic supporting shots

• Editing the complete 20–30 minute video

• Adding captions/subtitles

• Creating clean on-screen text and graphics

• Adding basic sound design and subtle music where appropriate

• Organising and delivering the complete project and source assets



The finished videos should feel:



• Realistic

• Contemporary

• Professional

• Story-driven

• Visually engaging

• Natural rather than obviously AI-generated



I DO NOT WANT:



• Generic stock-footage compilations

• Slideshow-style videos

• Obvious low-quality AI imagery

• Cartoon-like characters

• Overly flashy editing

• Someone who needs every individual shot explained to them



A major part of this role is being able to THINK LIKE AN EDITOR.



You should be able to read the script and decide independently:



• When a new AI-generated image is genuinely needed

• When an existing image can be reused with a crop, zoom or camera movement

• When a supporting cutaway is enough

• When stock footage is appropriate

• How to keep the viewer visually engaged without generating unnecessary assets

• How to communicate emotion and story visually



CHARACTER CONSISTENCY IS VERY IMPORTANT.



You must be able to take approved character reference images and keep that same person recognisable across different scenes, environments, angles and future episodes.



Please only apply if you have genuine experience with AI-generated images or AI-assisted video production.



Useful tools may include Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, Kling, Runway, Veo, Seedance, Higgsfield or similar AI image/video tools.



You do not need experience with every tool listed.



I care much more about your visual judgement, storytelling ability and ability to maintain character consistency than which specific software you use.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY:



This is intended to become an ongoing high-volume project.



Once the workflow is established, there is potential for approximately 20 completed videos per month.



I am looking for someone who wants stable recurring work and can maintain consistent quality and reliable turnaround times.



PAID TRIAL:



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete the same short paid editing trial.



For the trial, I will provide:



• Short script extract

• Finished audio

• Approved character reference images

• Visual/creative brief



The trial is used to assess character consistency, AI visual quality, storytelling, pacing, independent editorial judgement and overall editing quality.



This is a paid trial. I do not request free sample work.



Full trial details and payment will be provided only to shortlisted candidates.



For the trial, I will provide:



• Short script extract

• Finished audio

• Approved character reference images

• Visual/creative brief



This is a paid trial. I do not ask for free sample work.



ONGOING PRICE:



Please include your proposed FIXED PRICE per completed 20–30 minute video for ongoing work.



Please price with the potential recurring monthly volume in mind.



APPLICATION:



Please include:



1. Links to 2–3 examples of your strongest long-form YouTube videos.



2. At least one example using AI-generated images, AI video or recurring AI characters.



3. Which AI image/video tools you currently use.



4. Whether you have maintained the same recurring character across multiple AI-generated scenes, and how you do this.



5. Approximately how long one completed 20–30 minute video would take once the workflow is established.



6. Whether you have capacity to eventually produce approximately 20 videos per month.



7. Your proposed fixed price per completed 20–30 minute video for ongoing work.



8. Which editing software you normally use.



Please begin your application with the words:



LONG-TERM AI EDITOR



This shows me that you have read the full job description.



I am looking for someone who can potentially become a trusted long-term part of the production workflow, so reliability, communication, attention to detail and consistency are extremely important.

How to Apply

Recognition. Reimagined.



Applications without this phrase will not be reviewed.

title: Data Scientist
description:

* Build charts in code

* Find interesting economic and financial trends

* Turn those findings into clear visual stories

* Commit your work directly into our shared GitHub repo

* Figure things out without needing every step explained



## What we need



* Experience using AI and coding agents to build real things

* Comfortable working directly in GitHub

* Real scraping experience

* Comfortable working with messy data

* Able to build charts in code

* Strong analytical thinking

title: Video Editor & Social Media Content Editor
description:
Video Editor & Social Media Content Editor



**Remote |  | Long-Term Position**



We are looking for a talented and reliable full-time video editor to join our growing outdoor media and charter fishing/hunting businesses in the United States.



This is NOT a short-term freelance project.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and can grow with our company.



## What You'll Be Editing



We produce a large amount of professional fishing, hunting, boating and outdoor content throughout the United States.



Our content includes:



* Fishing trips

* Hunting trips

* YouTube videos

* Television/outdoor-show content

* Fishing charter content

* Hunting outfitter content

* Sponsor/product content

* Educational fishing and hunting videos

* Social media content

* Behind-the-scenes footage



You will receive raw footage and turn it into professional, engaging content.



## Your Responsibilities



### Long-Form Video



Edit professional long-form videos for YouTube and other platforms.



Typical responsibilities include:



* Selecting the best footage

* Building the story of the video

* Removing unnecessary or boring footage

* Creating engaging openings/hooks

* Adding B-roll

* Music selection

* Sound effects

* Audio cleanup

* Color correction

* Titles and graphics

* Transitions when appropriate

* Keeping viewers engaged throughout the video



Good editing is more than cutting clips together.



**Storytelling and viewer retention are extremely important to us.**



### Short-Form Content



Turn our long-form footage into high-performing vertical content for:



* Instagram Reels

*
 Reels

* YouTube Shorts

* TikTok



You will be expected to identify good moments yourself rather than waiting for us to give you timestamps for every clip.



Short-form edits may include:



* Strong hooks

* Captions

* Zooms

* Sound effects

* Music

* B-roll

* Graphics

* Fast-paced editing

* Calls to action when appropriate



### Content Repurposing



Our goal is to get as much quality content as possible from every filming day.



One fishing or hunting trip may produce:



* 1 long-form YouTube video

* Multiple Shorts/Reels

* Sponsor clips

* Educational clips

* Promotional clips

* Website footage



We want someone who can look at raw footage and recognize opportunities for additional content.



## Brands You'll Work With



You will create content for several fishing, hunting and outdoor brands as well as our outdoor television/digital show, **We Caught That**.



The content is primarily fishing, hunting, boating, outdoor adventure and related sponsor content.



Knowledge of fishing or hunting is a major advantage, but it is not required if you are willing to learn.



## Software



Experience with professional editing software is required.



Preferred:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Adobe After Effects

* DaVinci Resolve

* Photoshop or similar software



You must have your own reliable computer capable of editing high-resolution video and a reliable internet connection.



## What We're Looking For



You should be:



* Reliable

* Organized

* Creative

* Detail-oriented

* Able to meet deadlines

* Comfortable working independently

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Willing to learn our brands and editing style

* Able to receive constructive feedback

* Interested in a long-term position



We strongly value someone who can eventually watch footage and make good editing decisions without needing constant instructions.



## Schedule



This is intended to become a **full-time position of approximately 30-40 hours per week**.



We are located in the United States, but you do not need to work entirely during U.S. business hours.



We do require reliable communication and reasonable availability for messages, feedback and project updates.



## Compensation



**Starting salary: $700–$900 USD per month depending on experience and ability.**



There is opportunity for increased compensation based on performance, reliability, editing quality and the amount of responsibility you can handle independently.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your name and location.

2. A brief description of your video-editing experience.

3. How many years you have been editing.

4. What editing software you use.

5. Your computer specifications.

6. Your internet speed.

7. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

8. Links to your **three best video edits**.

9. At least one example of a long-form YouTube video you edited.

10. At least three examples of Shorts/Reels you edited.



Please also answer:



**If you received two hours of raw fishing footage and were asked to create a 10–15 minute YouTube video, explain how you would decide what footage to keep and how you would structure the video.**



### IMPORTANT



To show that you read the entire job posting, begin your application with the words:



**BIG REDFISH**



Applications that do not begin with BIG REDFISH may not be considered.



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a **paid test edit using the same raw footage** so we can compare editing ability, creativity, storytelling and attention to detail.



We are not necessarily looking for the person with the fanciest resume.



**We are looking for someone talented, reliable, creative and hungry to grow with our company.**

title: CHAT MODERATOR
description:
We are looking for a proactive, detail‑oriented Remote Chat Moderator to join our growing team. In this role, you will be the first line of defense in maintaining a positive, respectful environment across our chat rooms and forums. Whether you’re a seasoned moderator or just starting your career in community management, this entry‑level position offers competitive pay, flexible scheduling, and a chance to grow with a forward‑thinking company.



Key Highlights

Start Date: Immediate openings available

Compensation: $25–$35 per hour, commensurate with experience and performance

Location: Fully remote – work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection

Schedule: Flexible shifts; discuss your availability during the interview process

Career Path: Clear progression to Senior Moderator, Community Manager, or Product Specialist roles



What You’ll Do

As a Remote Chat Moderator, you will be responsible for ensuring that all interactions within our online spaces remain respectful, constructive, and aligned with community guidelines.



Your daily tasks will include:

* Monitoring live chat rooms, discussion boards, and user-generated content in real time.

* Enforcing community standards by issuing warnings, removing inappropriate content, and, when necessary, suspending or banning users.

* Responding promptly to user inquiries, concerns, and conflict situations with empathy and professionalism.

* Documenting i
, moderation actions, and user feedback in our internal tracking system.

* Collaborating with the Community Management team to refine policies, develop training materials, and share best practices.

* Participating in periodic training sessions and workshops to stay current on emerging moderation tools and industry trends.



Essential Qualifications

We’re looking for candidates who bring a blend of technical aptitude, strong communication skills, and a passion for community building. 



The following are essential:

* High school diploma or equivalent; a bachelor’s degree in Communications, Psychology, or a related field is a plus.

* Excellent written communication skills in English; additional languages are a bonus.

* Prior experience moderating online communities, forums, or social media platforms (even informal or volunteer roles).

* Proficiency with basic computer applications (Word, Excel,
) and familiarity with chat moderation tools (e.g., 
, Slack, or proprietary platforms).

* Strong multitasking abilities and the capacity to prioritize tasks in a fast‑paced environment.

* High level of integrity, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive or potentially upsetting content with professionalism.



Preferred Qualifications

While not mandatory, the following will give you an edge:

* Experience with content moderation software (e.g., ModSquad, Zendesk, or similar).

* Knowledge of cyber‑bullying, harassment, and online safety best practices.

* Background in customer support or technical support roles.

* Experience working in a remote or distributed team environment.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to generate reports on moderation metrics.

* Skills & Competencies

* Success in this role requires a blend of soft and hard skills:

Communication: Clear, concise, and empathetic written communication.

Critical Thinking: Ability to assess situations quickly and make sound decisions.

Attention to Detail: Spotting subtle violations and patterns of behavior.

Adaptability: Thriving in a dynamic environment with evolving policies.

Team Collaboration: Working effectively with cross‑functional teams (Product, Engineering, Legal).

Time Management: Managing multiple chat streams and tasks simultaneously.



Career Growth & Learning Opportunities

We believe in nurturing talent and providing clear pathways for advancement. 

As a Remote Chat Moderator, you’ll have the opportunity to:

* Progress to a Senior Moderator role, taking on larger communities and more complex moderation scenarios.

* Transition into a Community Manager position, overseeing strategy, policy development, and community engagement initiatives.

* Explore product or engineering roles by leveraging your deep understanding of user behavior and platform dynamics.

* Participate in our internal mentorship program, pairing you with experienced leaders across the organization.

* Attend industry conferences, webinars, and workshops to stay ahead of emerging trends in online safety and community management.



Work Environment & Culture

Our culture is built on transparency, collaboration, and a shared commitment to creating safe digital spaces. Key aspects include:



* Remote‑First: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.

* Inclusive & Diverse: A workforce that reflects the global communities we serve.

* Open Communication: Regular all‑hands meetings, town halls, and an open‑door policy for feedback.

* Employee Well‑Being: Access to mental health resources, flexible work hours, and a generous paid time off policy.

* Community Impact: Knowing that your work directly contributes to a safer, more welcoming online environment.



Compensation, Perks & Benefits

While the hourly rate is competitive, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your professional and personal life:



* Competitive hourly pay ($25–$35/hr) with performance‑based bonuses.

* Health, dental, and vision insurance options (for full‑time equivalents).

* Retirement savings plan with company match (for full‑time equivalents).

* Unlimited paid time off policy to encourage work‑life balance.

* Monthly stipend for home office equipment and high‑speed internet.

* Access to an employee wellness portal, including mental health counseling and fitness memberships.

* Regular team virtual events, hackathons, and community service opportunities.

title: Supply Chain & Fulfillment Manager – Dropshipping (CJ Dropshipping, Fashion)
description:
About us

We run 5 online fashion stores on Shopify. They sell to Denmark, the UK, Australia, Poland and the US. Most of our products are sourced and shipped through CJ Dropshipping. We are growing, and we need one person who owns everything between "order placed" and "customer happy with their package".



What you will do



Orders & delivery



Check every day that all orders reached the supplier with the right variant, size and address, and that nothing is stuck

Follow up on orders that are not shipped within the agreed processing time

Monitor tracking and act before a delay turns into a complaint

Make sure tracking numbers are synced to Shopify

Handle address changes, lost parcels, customs issues and returned-to-sender packages with the supplier



Supplier communication



Be the daily contact person for our CJ agents

Pick the best shipping line per country (speed vs. cost)

Flag out-of-stock items and price changes before they hurt sales



Quality control



Check the supplier's QC photos before items ship, especially for bestsellers and new products

Compare what customers received with our product listing (colour, material, sizing)

Spot recurring quality problems per product and advise whether to keep, replace or remove it



Disputes & returns



Open and follow up on disputes with the supplier for wrong items, defects, damage and late shipments, with proof

Track the outcome of every dispute until we get a refund or reshipment



Cost & negotiation



Negotiate better product and shipping prices on our bestsellers

Source alternative suppliers when quality, price or speed is not good enough

Order samples of new bestsellers when needed



Working with customer support



Work closely with our support team (Gorgias + Slack)

Give them fast, accurate shipping updates so they can answer customers

Share known delays proactively, before customers ask



Reporting



A short weekly report: processing time, delivery time per country, delayed orders, disputes opened/won, refunds recovered

Keep our order-tracking sheet (Google Sheets) up to date

Write down your processes (SOPs) so the work is repeatable



Requirements



At least 2 years of experience in dropshipping fulfillment or supply chain

Hands-on experience with CJ Dropshipping (strong plus), or AliExpress, Zendrop or a private agent

Experience with Shopify order management

Experience with supplier disputes and claims

Very good written English; you are firm but polite in negotiations

Organized and proactive: you notice a problem before someone asks

Comfortable with Google Sheets, Slack and tracking tools (17Track, ParcelPanel or similar)

Stable internet and a backup power/connection



Nice to have



Experience with fashion/apparel (sizing issues, returns)

Experience with shipping to Europe, the UK, Australia and the US

Basic Mandarin



How to apply

Start your application with the words "CJ ORDERS" so we know you read the full post. Then answer briefly:



Which dropshipping suppliers or agents have you worked with, and for how long?

Describe one dispute you won with a supplier. What did you do?

A customer's order has had no tracking update for 12 days. What are your first 3 steps?

What was the best price reduction you negotiated, and how?

title: Amazon PPC and Listing Specialist for Amazon.de (Part-time, 10h/week, long-term)
description:
We are a German dietary supplement brand (vitamins, minerals, capsules) selling on 
. The account is run by the founder, and we want one person who takes ownership of Amazon Germany: ads, listings, account health, and the rules that come with supplements.



YOUR JOB

- PPC: build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display. German keyword research, bids, negatives, budgets, weekly optimization. Targets: profitable ACoS, growing organic rank, more repeat buyers via Subscribe & Save

- Listings: titles, bullets, backend keywords, A+ content and images. Copy is German, we provide translations and product facts, you provide structure, keyword logic and conversion thinking

- Compliance: you know that supplements on 
 have strict rules. No health or healing claims (EU Health Claims Regulation 1924/2006), only approved claims, correct dosage and warning texts, restricted keywords in ads. You check every listing and every ad against these rules before it goes live, and you tell us when Amazon changes something

- Account health: Buy Box, inventory (FBA), suppressed or blocked listings, category approvals, Seller Support cases, reviews and Vine

- Reporting: one short weekly Google Sheet: ad spend, sales, ACoS, TACoS, organic vs paid, Subscribe & Save share, rank of our top products, what you changed and why

- Competitors: watch the other supplement sellers in our categories and report price, listing and ad changes



WHAT WE EXPECT

- At least 2 years hands-on in Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Ads, ideally with supplements, health or beauty products on a European marketplace (DE, FR, IT, ES or UK)

- You can show accounts you managed with spend, ACoS and sales growth (screenshots, client names blurred is fine)

- You have dealt with restricted categories, listing suppressions or claim rejections before and can describe how you solved them

- Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive or similar for German keyword research (you dont need to speak German, we check language, you check data). Basic German reading is a plus

- Honest reporting, also when numbers are bad

- Clear, short English



SETUP

- 10 hours per week to start, more when the account grows

- $5 to $6 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly via Wise or PayPal

- Long-term, ongoing

- Flexible hours, one weekly call with the founder 

- Tools: Seller Central, Amazon Ads console, Helium 10 (we provide access), Google Sheets, Slack or WhatsApp



HOW TO APPLY

1. Write "KAPSEL" as the first word of your application so we know you read this

2. Send screenshots of 1 or 2 Amazon accounts you managed with ad spend, ACoS and sales visible

3. Answer in 3 sentences: Amazon suppressed our best-selling listing because of a claim in the bullet points. What do you do in the first 24 hours, and what do you change so it does not happen again?

Shortlisted candidates get a paid test task ($20, about 2 hours): a compliance and conversion audit of one of our listings on 
 plus a PPC structure proposal.

We do not hold inventory. Furnishings ship from the manufacturer on a coordinated timeline to a receiving warehouse for consolidation, damage inspection, and photos, then go out for white-glove delivery and install. Multiple projects run in parallel, so catching a delay early keeps it from ever reaching the client.



Key Responsibilities

* Order and Vendor Coordination: Track every item from order placement through delivery across multiple vendors, flagging delays and mismatches while there's still time to fix them

* Exception Handling: Own the first response to damage, delay, or availability problems the same day they surface. Escalate what needs escalation, resolve what doesn't

* Receiving and Install Coordination: Coordinate with receivers and install teams so timelines hold

* Status Accuracy: Keep project and order status current and correct. Confirm this is accurate before you flag it to anyone else

* Error Tracking: Log install and fulfillment errors by project so we can see where problems originate and reduce them over time

* Process Input: Flag where manual work is slowing things down and work with our automation team on fixes



What You Bring

* Experience coordinating orders, shipments, or vendor logistics

* Experience tracking and coordinating orders without owning or managing physical inventory

* Ability to catch problems before they escalate, not just respond once they're already client-facing

* Sharp attention to detail

* Clear, direct written and verbal communication, especially when something is going wrong

* Schedule flexibility to align with PT business hours

* Alignment with our core values (see below)



Company Core Values

RELATE: Humility, collaboration, and fun in everything we do

DISCOVER: Passion for innovation and continuous learning

DELIVER: Strong work ethic and personal accountability

DELIGHT: Commitment to exceptional client experiences

title: HR & Talent Operations Associate
description:
To apply, please click the link provided below: 



Job Title: HR & Talent Operations Associate

Location: Remote

Reports To: COO

Department: HR, Admin and Finance

Works Closely With: CSM, Finance & Recruitment

Work Shift: Flexible, broken hours, 8 hrs/day, 5 days per week

Working Hours: Full-Time; 40 hours per week



Role Purpose



This role owns the back office of More Staffing — contracts, invoices, records, onboarding and reporting — and, once that base is running cleanly, extends into keeping deployed talent supported, performing and engaged. The role is built in two tiers so that the administrative foundation is proven before people-facing ownership is added.



Tier 1 — Core Scope (from day one)



Contracts, Invoicing & Finance Support

Contracts and Invoice Creation and Management: Create and send contracts and invoices, monitor status until fully executed and paid, coordinate follow-ups, and maintain accurate records and file management.

Recurring Invoice Processing: Send and track recurring invoices, ensuring clients meet payment deadlines.

Masterfile Maintenance: Keep the Contracts and Invoices Masterfile, Client Activity Tracker and Client Masterlist current and accurate.

Tool & Subscription Monitoring: Work with Finance to track all tool and subscription expenses monthly for accurate records and cost visibility.

COGS Reporting: Prepare weekly COGS reports tracking recruiter time and hours per role and per client.

Talent Lifecycle Administration



Onboarding – Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and manage Talent Agreements, Independent Contractor Agreements and W-8BEN forms; maintain accurate onboarding records for internal and external talent.

Onboarding – Coordination & Setup: Coordinate tool access, tracker updates and internal notifications for a smooth start.

Offboarding: Manage and conduct offboarding, ensuring all steps and documentation are completed.

Talent Records Management: Maintain talent rosters, masterlists and movement records; keep Manatal and back-end file systems current.

Hubstaff Assistance: Handle requests, onboarding inquiries and account setup.

Certificate of Engagement Issuance: Process and distribute engagement certificates on request.

Data, Reporting & Systems



Data Backtracking and Consolidation: Consolidate current and historical HR and admin data from company
 and Google Drive into a complete, accurate dataset.

Reporting & Dashboards: Build and maintain weekly and monthly HR and admin reports and dashboards with key insights for management.

File Management: Organize HR and finance files for easy access and reference.

Domain &
 Management: Maintain company domains and company
 accounts, ensuring access and correct configuration.

SOP Creation: Develop and maintain SOPs for internal processes.

Process Gap Identification: Surface breakdowns, bottlenecks and manual workarounds observed in day-to-day work. Bring each one to the COO with a proposed fix; implement and document the agreed fix as an SOP. This is an expectation of the role, not an occasional extra.



Internal Team Engagement

Engagement Calendar: Own a rolling 90-day engagement calendar for the More Staffing internal team — planned and published in advance, not arranged week to week.

Virtual Engagement Activities: Plan and run recurring virtual activities (e.g. book club, games, learning sessions), including scheduling, reminders, materials and attendance tracking.

Recognition & Milestones: Ensure birthday and work-anniversary greetings are posted in the relevant Slack channel on the correct day, from a maintained milestone calendar. Zero missed dates is the standard.



General

Ad Hoc Tasks: Additional administrative and operational support as needed.

Tier 2 — Talent Success Scope (added after the 3-month review)



Added once Tier 1 is running reliably and unsupervised. The rate will be increased at this stage.



Managed / Partnership Model Account Support

Monthly Talent Calls: Conduct a monthly one-on-one call with every hire under the Managed / Partnership Model to confirm the engagement is on track, the talent is supported, and performance expectations are being met. Calls are scheduled in the calendar a quarter ahead, not booked reactively.

Performance & Availability Monitoring: Review output and availability signals (Hubstaff time, client feedback, deliverable cadence) against expectations. Flag discrepancies to the COO and CSM within 24 hours of identifying them, with the supporting evidence.

Coaching Coordination: Coordinate and track coaching and development activity for managed-model talent — scheduling, follow-through on agreed actions, and documentation of outcomes.

Social Events: Plan and run social events for managed-model talent under an agreed annual calendar and budget.

Check-In Documentation: Record every check-in against a standard template so notes are searchable and reportable, and surface patterns across the cohort in the monthly report.

Talent Check-Ins & Retention Recommendations



Concern-Triggered Check-Ins: Conduct check-ins when a client raises a concern; handle end-of-contract (EOC) and final check-ins as engagements approach expiration.

Performance Reviews: Conduct performance reviews, collect feedback and identify areas for growth.

Rehire Eligibility Recommendation: Following a client-raised concern or a separation, assess against a defined rubric whether the talent should be given a second chance, redeployed to a different client, or marked not eligible for rehire. Document the evidence and submit a written recommendation to the COO, who makes the final call. Maintain the rehire-eligibility flag in Manatal once d
.

Note: the rehire recommendation is a recommendation, not an independent decision. The COO retains the decision.



Required Attributes



Exceptional organization: Manages a high volume of parallel, deadline-bound items across contracts, invoices, onboarding and check-ins without items falling through. Works from a calendar and a tracker, not from memory or inbox order.

Attention to detail: This role touches contracts, invoices and direct client
. Errors are visible to clients and cost money. Accuracy in names, dates, figures and terms is non-negotiable.

Forward planning: Schedules recurring commitments — check-ins, engagement activities, invoice cycles, milestone greetings — ahead of time in the calendar rather than reacting to them.

Written communication: Clear, professional, plain English in client-facing
. Comfortable following up on unpaid invoices and unsigned contracts without escalation.

Ownership and problem-solving: Notices when a process is broken and brings a proposed fix rather than only the problem.

Discretion: Handles compensation, contract and performance information confidentially.

Judgment (Tier 2): Able to hold a difficult conversation with talent about performance, and to form and defend an evidence-based view on retention.



Tools:



Manatal, Hubstaff, Google Workspace (Drive, Sheets, Calendar, Gmail), Slack, QuickBooks, Notion.
