title: Graphic Designer (Paid Social and App Creative)
description:
Who We Are (
c)




c is the parent company of a portfolio of technology businesses, including Mode Mobile, the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software platform that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users worldwide to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, and shopping. We enable users to profit from their data and attention, rather than letting only tech giants benefit. What sets us apart is our inclusive approach, converting users into earners, facilitating over $150M in earnings and savings, and going a step further by turning earners into owners by awarding stock ownership in 
c based on their usage. We have attracted over 40 million users across 170 countries.



Mode Mobile, Inc. Ranked Number 1 Fastest Growing Company in North America on the 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500.



For additional insights, check out information about our reward-based super app, Mode Earn App, which also powers the reward engine for our proprietary smartphone, Mode Earn Phone.



## Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success



Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hardworking but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree but commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.



The Role



We're looking for a Graphic Designer to build the paid advertising and app store creative that scales a fast-growing portfolio of consumer apps spanning rewarded/earn, utility, and viral/social categories. You'll take concepts and briefs from our Creative Strategists and turn them into finished, testable visual assets for Meta, TikTok, AppLovin, Google, the Apple App Store, and Google Play: static ads, app-focused graphics, carousels, app store screenshots, feature graphics, promotional assets, and visual variations.



This is a hands-on design role. You are designing every day, shipping at volume, and thinking about creative through a performance marketing and conversion lens rather than purely from an aesthetic perspective. You'll work closely with our Creative Strategists, Creative Producers, and UA Managers to translate winning concepts into clear, compelling, and highly testable visual executions across both paid advertising and app store listings.



A major part of the role will be designing and iterating app store screenshots that clearly communicate what each app does, why users should care, and what differentiates it from competitors. You'll help create a strong visual connection between the ad a user clicks and the store listing they land on.



This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Growth & UA, with day-to-day creative direction from our Ad Creative Lead. It will begin as a part-time, hourly position, averaging 20–35 hours per week, with the potential to transition to full-time.



Who You Are and What You'll Do



Produce high-converting paid social graphics for our consumer app portfolio across Meta, TikTok, AppLovin, and Google



Design high-converting app store listing assets for the Apple App Store and Google Play, with a strong focus on screenshot sets, feature graphics, promotional graphics, and other store assets



Research competitor app ads and app store listings to identify recurring visual patterns, positioning, messaging, screenshot structures, and opportunities before designing new concepts



Turn strategist briefs into finished creative assets, including static ads, carousels, app-focused graphics, app store screenshots, promotional layouts, and visual variations without needing the brief explained twice



Translate app features and benefits into simple, compelling app store screenshot narratives that users can understand at a glance



Think strategically about screenshot sequencing, ensuring the strongest value propositions and product moments appear early in the listing and work together as a cohesive story



Build app-focused visuals that clearly demonstrate the product through real app screenshots, UI callouts, device mockups, comparison layouts, feature highlights, and visual storytelling



Design app store creative that connects naturally with the advertising that drove the user there, maintaining continuity between the promise made in the ad and the experience presented on the store page



Create multiple app store screenshot concepts and visual directions for testing different value propositions, messaging hierarchies, layouts, UI treatments, and feature prioritization



Design performance creative that communicates the core hook, product benefit, and offer within the first moment of exposure



Design for performance: strong visual hierarchy, scroll-stopping hooks, messaging clarity, typography, product storytelling, and a clear call to action



Develop multiple visual executions from the same core concept so we can test different hooks, layouts, imagery, headlines, CTAs, visual styles, and product moments



Ship at volume: 5–6 net new concepts per week with 5–6 variations each, adapted to the aspect ratios and placement specifications each network requires



Work directly with our Creative Strategists and UA Managers to understand how your creatives and store assets actually performed, then iterate on the visual patterns that win



Use AI creative tools to accelerate ideation, asset generation, image manipulation, visual exploration, and production, and help define workflows that let the team punch above its headcount



Maintain visual consistency and accuracy across app screens, branding, typography, product UI, and advertising claims while still allowing enough creative flexibility for rapid testing



## What You Bring to the Team:



3+ years designing paid advertising creative for consumer apps, or for direct response brands with meaningful performance marketing work in your portfolio



Strong experience designing app store listing creative, particularly Apple App Store and Google Play screenshot sets for consumer mobile apps



Hundreds, and ideally thousands, of paid advertising creatives and visual variations produced over the course of your career



A career primarily focused on performance marketing creative, app store creative, Meta ads, TikTok ads, in-app network creative such as AppLovin or Unity, app install ads, direct response design, and high-volume creative production rather than traditional brand design alone



Strong grasp of what makes a paid social ad convert: hooks, visual hierarchy, messaging, typography, product demonstration, legibility, pattern interruption, and creative testing



Strong understanding of what makes an app store listing convert, including screenshot sequencing, value proposition hierarchy, feature communication, visual storytelling, UI presentation, and message continuity from ad to store



Expert in Figma and Adobe Photoshop, with strong working proficiency in Illustrator



Strong ability to work with real app UI and transform product screenshots into polished, compelling marketing visuals without misrepresenting the product experience



AI native. ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Flux, Photoshop Generative Fill, or comparable platforms are already part of your creative workflow, not something you are currently learning



Data informed. Comfortable using performance data such as IPM, CTR, CPI/CPA, CVR, store conversion rate, D1 and D7 retention, and ROAS to understand what visual patterns are working and d
 what to build next, even without owning the analytics directly



Experience producing complete app store listing asset sets, including screenshots, feature graphics, promotional graphics, and localized variations



Experience creating and iterating app store screenshot concepts based on creative testing, competitor research, user motivations, product features, and performance learnings



Experience designing for multiple paid media placements and aspect ratios, including 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, and landscape formats



Experience working in fast-paced creative environments where new concepts and iterations are produced daily



Strong eye for typography, composition, hierarchy, layout, branding, UI presentation, and visual storytelling



Strong English communication, written and verbal. You can read a brief, ask the one question that matters, and deliver



Personal Attributes



Creative: A visionary thinker with the ability to develop innovative visual ideas that align with business goals and resonate with the target audience.



Efficient: Ability to work strategically and efficiently, optimizing resources to deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.



Adaptable: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote, and iterative environment.



Analytical: Passion for turning data into insight and insight into better-performing creative.



Collaborative: Energized by working with creative, growth, product, and data teams.



Alignment with our core Values:



Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self-discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.



Action driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.



Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.



Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.



Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.



This role requires strong visual craft and the discipline to ship at volume without letting quality slip, with particular strength in turning app features and value propositions into paid social and app store creative that drives conversion across a fast-growing, verticalized app portfolio.



If we just described you and your perfect role, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to making headway and creating success together!

title: B2B Lead Generation & Outreach Specialist – Part Time
description:
About the Role



I’m looking for an experienced B2B Lead Generation & Outreach Specialist to help grow the institutional and partnership side of LeadMeNot.



LeadMeNot is a digital wellness and accountability platform that helps individuals and organizations create healthier boundaries with technology and address harmful digital behaviors through cross-device blocking, monitoring and accountability tools.



We are growing our institutional distribution and are looking for someone who can help us consistently identify and reach the right organizations and decision-makers.



This role will be primarily focused on researched, personalized
 outreach, with targeted cold calling where appropriate.



Your job will be to identify high-quality organizations and decision-makers, research them, reach out by
 and phone, manage follow-ups and generate qualified conversations for me and the LeadMeNot team.



Organizations We Target



Our current target markets include:



Universities and secondary schools

Churches and church networks

Counseling centers and treatment organizations

Christian nonprofits and para-church ministries

Organizations focused on specific behavioral issues, including problem gambling and digital gambling

Employers interested in digital wellness or behavioral-health benefits

Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs)

Employee benefits brokers and consultants

Organizations that can distribute or bundle LeadMeNot across large populations



In addition to direct institutional sales, we are particularly interested in employer-sponsored and benefits-driven distribution, where an organization pays to provide LeadMeNot across a larger population.



There will also be opportunities to identify new markets, organizations and partnership channels we have not yet pursued.



This is not simply a list-building role.



I want someone who can understand why a particular organization might need LeadMeNot, who inside that organization would care, and how we should approach them.



What You'll Be Doing



You will be responsible for:



Researching organizations that fit our target customer profiles

Identifying the correct decision-makers within those organizations

Finding and verifying professional
 addresses and phone numbers

Building and maintaining accurate prospect lists

Researching individual prospects before contacting them

Writing personalized opening lines and outreach
s

Sending targeted cold
s and managing follow-up sequences

Making targeted cold calls when appropriate

Calling organizations to identify the correct decision-maker when contact information is unclear

Following up by phone with prospects who have already received
 outreach

Having brief introductory conversations and determining whether there is potential interest

Monitoring replies, bounce-backs and
 deliverability

Responding to straightforward replies using agreed information and templates

Asking for referrals when someone is not the correct contact

Identifying and handing over interested prospects

Booking qualified meetings directly into my calendar

Maintaining accurate records in our CRM and/or spreadsheets

Providing a simple weekly report on activity and results

Monitoring sender reputation and helping protect
 deliverability

Testing different messaging, audiences and outreach approaches

Suggesting improvements to targeting, messaging and our overall outbound process



Over time, I want you to become capable of looking at an organization, understanding the likely LeadMeNot use case, identifying the people we need to reach and developing a thoughtful strategy for reaching them.



Cold Calling Expectations



This is not a traditional high-volume call-center role.



I am not looking for someone making hundreds of generic calls per day from a script.



Phone outreach should be researched and targeted.



For example, you may:



Call a university to determine who oversees student wellness

Call a church to identify the staff member responsible for care, counseling, family ministry or another relevant area

Call an organization to determine who manages employee benefits or wellness

Follow up with someone who has already received an

Speak briefly with a decision-maker to determine whether LeadMeNot could be relevant

Book an interested prospect directly into my calendar



You would not generally be expected to run full sales presentations, negotiate contracts or independently close complex institutional deals.



This Role Does NOT Primarily Involve

High-volume telemarketing

Hundreds of scripted cold calls per day

Closing complex sales deals

Giving full product demonstrations

Negotiating contracts

Sending thousands of generic
s

Spam-style automated outreach



I care much more about 100 well-researched prospects who genuinely fit LeadMeNot than 5,000 names dumped into an automated sequence.



The goal is qualified conversations and ultimately revenue, not vanity metrics.



Experience I'm Looking For



You should have previous experience with several of the following:



B2B lead generation

Cold
 outreach

Cold calling and phone-based prospecting

LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Apollo.io


 verification tools

Personalized B2B prospecting

Inbox and reply management


 deliverability

CRM and pipeline management

Prospect research

Multi-step outreach sequences



Experience prospecting into any of the following would be especially valuable:



Universities or schools

Churches or ministries

Healthcare or behavioral health

HR and employee benefits

Employee Assistance Programs

Nonprofits

SaaS or technology partnerships



Excellent written and spoken English is essential.



You should be able to write short, natural
s that sound like they came from a real person who actually researched the recipient rather than generic AI-generated sales copy.



Good judgment is extremely important.



I don't want someone who simply follows a list of instructions. I want someone who can look at a prospect and think:



Who is actually the right person here? Why would they care about LeadMeNot? What's the best way to get their attention?



Tools



LeadMeNot will pay for and provide access to the tools required for the role.



These may include:



Apollo

LinkedIn Sales Navigator


 verification software

CRM/outreach software

Google Workspace

Other prospecting and research tools as needed



You will need your own reliable computer and internet connection.



Working Hours



20 hours per week.



Hours can be flexible, although I would like some overlap with U.S. working hours on working days so interested replies can be handled quickly and phone outreach can take place during normal U.S. business hours.



Compensation & Performance Incentives



Base compensation: ₱37,000 per month, paid once monthly.



In addition to base compensation, this role includes significant performance-based upside.



The intent is to reward quality opportunities and actual business generated, rather than simply the number of
s sent or calls made.



Qualified Meeting Bonus



₱1,000 for every qualified meeting that actually takes place.



A qualified meeting means a meeting with a relevant decision-maker or strong internal influencer at an organization that reasonably fits one of LeadMeNot's target customer or partnership profiles.



Closed-Deal Commission



For organizations that you personally source and originate through your outbound prospecting and that subsequently become paying LeadMeNot customers or partners:



10% → Deals up to $20,000

20% → Deals from $20,000–$40,000

30% → Deals from $40,000–$500,000

40% → Deals of $500,000+



Commission is paid on closed and collected contract value, not proposals, verbal commitments or contracts for which LeadMeNot has not yet received payment.



Performance Accelerators



As you generate more cumulative closed business for LeadMeNot, your commission percentage on future deals increases:



$20,000 cumulative closed → +5% on future deals

$100,000 cumulative closed → +10% on future deals

$250,000 cumulative closed → +15% on future deals



Accelerators stack on top of the applicable base commission rate and apply prospectively, not retroactively.



For example:



If you source four $5,000 deals, you have generated $20,000 in cumulative closed business.



Each of those deals earns the normal 10% commission.



Once the $20,000 threshold has been reached, future deals earn the applicable base commission plus an additional 5%.



Once cumulative closed business reaches $100,000, future deals earn the applicable base commission plus 10%.



The intent is to heavily reward someone who becomes exceptionally good at creating meaningful new business for LeadMeNot.



Commission Eligibility



Commission eligibility applies to new opportunities personally sourced and originated through your outreach.



It does not apply to existing LeadMeNot customers, active opportunities, inbound leads or relationships already in our pipeline unless agreed otherwise in advance.



Commission is based on revenue actually collected by LeadMeNot from the opportunity you originated.



About LeadMeNot



LeadMeNot is a digital wellness and accountability platform designed to help people create healthier boundaries with technology.



Our software works across iOS, Android, Windows, Mac and Chromebook and allows users to create rules around websites, apps, keywords and categories of harmful digital behavior.



LeadMeNot began as a direct-to-consumer product and is now expanding its institutional distribution through universities, churches, counseling organizations, nonprofits, employers and other strategic partners.



We already have paying institutional customers and are actively building this side of the business.



You would be joining at an early stage of our B2B growth, which means there is significant opportunity to help shape our prospecting strategy, messaging, target markets and overall sales process.



For someone who consistently generates high-quality opportunities and revenue, there is substantial room to grow with the company.



To Apply



Please include:



A short introduction explaining your relevant experience.

How many years you have worked in B2B lead generation and cold outreach.

Which lead-generation, research and outreach tools you have personally used.

The industries and types of organizations you have previously targeted.

An example of a cold
 campaign you personally managed, including approximate number of prospects contacted, response rate, meetings generated and results.

Your experience with cold calling or phone-based B2B prospecting, including approximately how many calls you were responsible for making.

Your experience with
 deliverability and
 verification.

An example of how you research and personalize outreach before contacting a prospect.

Confirmation that you are comfortable with a role that includes both
 outreach and targeted cold calling.

Confirmation that you are available for 20 hours per week.

Your current employment, freelance work or other client commitments.



Please include the word "accountability" somewhere in your application so I know you read the full job description.

title: Shopify Finance, Payments & Chargeback Specialist / Bookkeeper
description:
Shopify Finance, Payments & Chargeback Specialist / Bookkeeper



We operate a **7-figure Shopify e-commerce business** and are looking for an experienced **Shopify Finance, Payments & Chargeback Specialist / Bookkeeper**.



This is **not a general VA position**. We need someone who understands Shopify deeply, especially **Shopify Payments, payouts, chargebacks, refunds, fulfillment, bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation**.



### What We Need Help With



**Shopify Payments & Held Funds**



* Investigate our current Shopify Payments hold/reserve and understand why funds are being held.

* Review Shopify's communications and requirements regarding the hold.

* Help us prepare the correct documentation and information for any available Shopify review/appeal.

* Track held funds, reserves, pending payouts, and released payouts.

* Help us understand exactly how much money Shopify is holding and what has been paid out.



**Chargebacks, Refunds & Orders**



* Review our chargebacks and refunds and determine why they are happening.

* Determine whether **orders that were refunded or charged back were still shipped/fulfilled**.

* Identify situations where we lost the refund/chargeback amount **plus the product and shipping cost**.

* Help create a system so refunded/canceled orders are stopped from shipping whenever appropriate and possible.

* Work with Chargeflow/RDR and help improve our chargeback process.

* Help us reduce future chargebacks.



**Financial Reconciliation — Where Did Our Money Go?**



We need someone who can take our Shopify revenue and clearly reconcile it against:



* Shopify Payments payouts

* Funds held/reserved by Shopify

* Chargebacks

* Refunds

* RDR/pre-dispute refunds

* Shopify/payment processing fees

* Chargeflow fees

* Shopify apps and software expenses

* Advertising expenses

* COGS/product costs

* Shipping and fulfillment expenses

* Other business expenses

* Actual money deposited into our bank accounts



At any time, we should be able to understand:



**Revenue → Expenses → Refunds/Chargebacks → Held Funds → Payouts → Bank Deposits → Actual Profit**



### Bookkeeping



We also need someone who can handle ongoing bookkeeping for the company, including:



* Monthly bookkeeping

* Shopify and bank reconciliation

* Shopify Payments payout reconciliation

* Expense categorization

* Chargeback/refund reconciliation

* Monthly P&L

* Cash-flow reporting

* Tracking business expenses

* QuickBooks or Xero

* Working with our accountant/CPA when needed



### Who We're Looking For



You should have:



* Strong Shopify expertise

* Shopify Payments experience

* E-commerce bookkeeping experience

* Experience reconciling Shopify payouts with bank deposits

* Experience with refunds and chargebacks

* Understanding of Shopify Payments reserves/holds

* Experience with Chargeflow/RDR is a big plus

* QuickBooks and/or Xero experience

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Experience with a **7-figure+ e-commerce business** is strongly preferred



We are **not** looking for someone who promises they can guarantee Shopify will release our funds. We want someone who understands Shopify Payments risk, can help us address the underlying issues, and can prepare the business properly for Shopify's review.



### How to Apply



Start your application with **“SHOPIFY FINANCE”** and answer these 5 questions:



**1.** Tell us about your experience managing finances/bookkeeping for Shopify stores. What size stores have you worked with?



**2.** Have you dealt with **Shopify Payments holds/reserves, chargebacks, RDR, or Chargeflow**? Briefly explain your experience.



**3.** If Shopify shows **$200,000 in sales but only $130,000 reached our bank account**, how would you determine exactly where the other $70,000 went?



**4.** How would you identify **refunded or chargeback orders that were still shipped**, and help us prevent this from happening again?



**5.** What accounting/bookkeeping tools do you use, and what is your expected hourly or monthly rate?



We are looking for someone **long-term** who can take ownership of our Shopify financial reporting and help us have a clear understanding of where every dollar is going.

title: 💰 ELITE RETENTION & SALES CLOSER
description:
**Can You Hear “No” — And Keep Selling?**



We’re looking for the **crème de la crème of sales and retention closers.**



The person who hears:



**“I want a refund.”**

**“Cancel my subscription.”**

**“It’s too expensive.”**

**“I’m not interested.”**



…and thinks:



**Challenge accepted.**



If you know how to uncover the REAL objection, articulate value, rebuild confidence, close the save — and recognize the right moment to **upsell or cross-sell** —



**SHOW US THE MONEY. 💰**



🔥 THIS IS NOT CUSTOMER SERVICE



We’re ECX, a retention-first Customer Experience agency supporting leading U.S. health, wellness, supplement, and eCommerce brands.



Our frontline team is where customer experience meets **revenue.**



You won’t spend your day simply answering questions and closing tickets.



Your job is to:



**SAVE THE CUSTOMER. PROTECT THE REVENUE. FIND THE OPPORTUNITY. CLOSE.**



We want experienced sales and retention professionals who are competitive, emotionally intelligent, persuasive, resilient — and **not afraid to ASK FOR THE SALE.**



 🎯 WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO



You’ll handle inbound and outbound customer conversations where revenue is on the line.



That means:



Turn refund requests into retained customers

• Save subscription cancellations

• Uncover the real objection instead of accepting the first “no”

• Articulate product value clearly and confidently

• Match customers with solutions that make sense

• Upsell and cross-sell when the opportunity exists

• Handle objections without becoming defensive or robotic

• Build trust quickly with frustrated customers

• Protect the customer relationship while protecting revenue

• Document accurately and remain compliant



We sell with integrity.



But make no mistake:



We SELL.



🐺 ARE YOU A CLOSER?



We’re looking for people who already have the instincts.



You understand that “no” may mean:



I don't see the value yet.

You haven't solved my problem yet.

I don't trust this yet.



You listen.



You ask better questions.



You understand the customer's motivation.



You communicate value.



And then...



You ask for the close.



If asking for the sale makes you uncomfortable, this probably isn't your team.



🏆 EXPERIENCED CLOSERS ONLY



We want candidates with proven experience in:



Sales | Retention | Save-the-Sale | Upselling | Cross-Selling | Objection Handling



Health, wellness, supplements, D2C/eCommerce, subscription products, or high-volume contact center experience is a major plus.



You should be able to talk confidently about:



• Your previous sales or retention results

• Quotas or KPIs you've carried

• Your save or close rates

• Sales methodologies or training you've received

• How you handle difficult objections

• How you turn a “no” into an opportunity



We are not hiring entry-level customer service agents for this role.



🎓 WE'LL MAKE GREAT CLOSERS EVEN BETTER



Bring us your sales instincts.



We'll give you our playbook.



You'll learn our approach to:



• The Anatomy of the Perfect Call — Take control from the opening

• The Retention Playbook — Know where to take the conversation next

• White Glove Retention — Turn frustration into trust

• Advanced Objection Handling — Get beyond the surface-level “no”

• Value-Based Selling — Communicate why the product is worth keeping

• Upselling & Cross-Selling — Recognize opportunities and confidently ask

• AI-Assisted Retention — Use technology to strengthen your conversations

• Compliance & Accuracy — Close the right way



We don't want scripts that sound like scripts.



We develop professional closers.



💵 PERFORMANCE PAYS



Starting Pay: $5 USD/Hour



PLUS:



💰 Save + Sales Incentives & Bonuses

💰 Performance-Based Increases After 90 Days

🚀 Advancement Opportunities for Top Performers



Shift Options — U.S. EST



9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST



or



12:00 PM – 9:00 PM EST



We reward results.



📊 YOUR SCOREBOARD



You'll know exactly how you're performing.



We measure:



Save Rate | Sales | Upsells/Cross-Sells | CSAT | Quality | Compliance | Attendance



Your numbers tell the story.



Top performers get recognized.



❤️ WHY ECX?



My name is Sheneen Ellis, and I've spent more than 20 years building and leading high-performing customer retention organizations. I'm building an elite frontline team for major health and wellness brands — and I want people who genuinely want to master the craft of retention and sales.  If you're looking for a place to hide in the queue, this isn't it. If you want to compete, learn, earn, and become exceptionally good at closing — welcome home.



🚨 THINK YOU'RE TOP 1%? PROVE IT.



This is your first sales opportunity.



Sell us on YOU.



Send us a 2-minute video and tell us:



Where have you worked in sales or retention?

What were your sales, close, or save rates?

What quotas or KPIs were you responsible for?

What formal sales or communication training have you received?

Why do you believe you're a top 1% closer?



YOU MUST ALSO SUBMIT:



• Your updated resume

• Screenshot of your internet speed test

• Photo of your professional workspace

• Your computer specifications — RAM + Processor



APPLICATION SUBJECT: “SHOW ME THE MONEY — [YOUR NAME]” 💰



⚠️ APPLICATIONS WITHOUT ALL REQUESTED MATERIALS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



No generic applications.



No “I'm a fast learner.”



No “Give me a chance.”



Show us what you've already done.



If you're confident enough to bet on your ability to perform, resilient enough to hear “no,” skilled enough to create value, and hungry enough to ask for the close...



LET'S SEE WHAT YOU'VE GOT. 🔥💰

title: EMAIL MARKETING ACCOUNT MANAGER (KLAVIYO) - REMOTE, FULL-TIME
description:
EMAIL MARKETING ACCOUNT MANAGER (KLAVIYO) - REMOTE, FULL-TIME





ABOUT US



EAZYFLOWS is a small
 marketing agency. We build and run Klaviyo for

Shopify brands in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Flows, campaigns,

retention. The team is fully remote.





WHAT THIS ROLE IS



You run the Klaviyo accounts. You do not talk to clients.



All client communication goes through me. You bring me everything I need in

our calls, and I speak to the client. Your job is to make sure I always have

the full picture: what happened in the account, what the numbers say, and

what you recommend.



This is an execution and analysis role, not a client-facing role.





YOUR DAILY WORK



- Check every account, every day. Make sure campaigns sent, flows are live,

  and nothing is broken.

- Look for small improvements every day and make them.

- Post a short daily update in Slack. What you did, what you found, what is

  blocked.





YOUR WEEKLY WORK



- Join our internal call. Bring the status of every account.

- Review the client calls I have, pull out the feedback, and put that

  feedback into the Klaviyo account.

- Build hypotheses from the data. Example: "This flow has a low click rate,

  I think the CTA sits too far down." We discuss your hypotheses in the call.

- Set up and run the A/B tests we agree on. Track them until they have a

  result.

- Manage Alia. Check that it is running correctly and that the tests inside

  it are live.

- Manage pop-ups. Check they are working, and test them.





YOUR MONTHLY WORK



- Build the monthly report for each account.

- Prepare the key learnings before the call, not during it.

- Present the report to me and walk me through what the numbers mean and

  what we should do next.





WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



- No client calls, no client
s, no client chat.

- No cold outreach, no sales.

- No copywriting, no design. We have people for that.





REQUIREMENTS



- 2 to 3 years of experience minimum in
 marketing.

- Agency experience is required. This is the most important point. You must

  have worked on several client accounts at the same time.

- Strong Klaviyo skills. You must be able to build flows, build segments,

  set up A/B tests, and read a report.

- Strong English. You do not need to speak German.

- You will implement in German. The copy and the
s are in German. You

  do not write them, but you must be careful and accurate when you place

  German text into Klaviyo. Attention to detail matters here.

- Communication is the most important skill in this role. Daily updates,

  clear messages, no silence. Everything runs through Slack.

- You are reliable. When you say a task is done, it is done.





PAY



- Fixed retainer: EUR 750 per month.

- Bonus on top for consistent work and reliability.

- Bonus on top when account performance improves.



We agree the bonus targets together after a short trial period, once I have

seen how you work.





HOW TO APPLY



I want to see your real track record. Not promises, not a list of skills.

I want to see what you actually did and what came out of it.



Please send me the following. Take your time with it. I read every

application properly.



1. ABOUT YOU

A short introduction. Who you are, where you are based, and how long you

have been working in
 marketing.



2. HOW YOU WORK

Describe a normal working day for you. How do you organise your accounts?

What do you check first? What tools do you use? I want to understand how you

think, not just what you know.



3. YOUR AGENCY HISTORY

Which agencies have you worked with? Name them. For each one, tell me:

- how long you were there

- what your role was

- how many client accounts you managed at the same time

- which industries the clients were in



4. YOUR RESULTS - THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART

Give me at least two real examples of accounts you managed. For each one:

- where the account was when you took it over

- what you changed and why

- where the account was when you handed it over, or where it is today



Please use real numbers.
 revenue share, flow revenue, click rates,

list growth, whatever you measured. Before and after.



If you cannot share exact numbers because of an NDA, give me the percentage

change instead and say that it is under NDA. That is fine. Inventing numbers

is not.



Screenshots from Klaviyo are very welcome. They help me a lot.



5. YOUR AVAILABILITY

When you can start, how many hours per week, and which time zone you work in.





Please start your message with the word GERMANY. This tells me you read the

full post.



A short answer with no examples and no numbers will not be considered. I am

not looking for someone who promises well. I am looking for someone who

delivers and can show it.

title: Supply Chain & Operations Coordinator
description:
To be considered for this role, please apply directly through our careers page so we can properly review your application.



Fill out the application form here: 



Job Title: Supply Chain & Operations Coordinator

Location: Remote

Reports To: COO

Work Shift: US business hours preferred, with flexibility for Pacific Time overlap

Working Hours: Full-Time



Job Description



We are seeking a Supply Chain & Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operational work of a growing ecommerce brand.



The business manufactures its products in China, coordinates international freight through Flexport, and fulfills orders through a third-party logistics partner in Southern California. This role is intended to take ownership of the recurring operational tasks currently handled by the founder and COO, helping keep shipments, inventory movements, wholesale administration, and other executional workflows moving smoothly.



This is an execution-focused role rather than a strategic supply chain position. The ideal candidate is highly organized, communicative, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing straightforward but important operational tasks independently.



Key Responsibilities



Freight & Shipment Coordination

Support international freight bookings through Flexport

Request and review freight quotes as needed

Coordinate shipment details and required documentation with internal stakeholders and external partners

Prepare and send carton markings and other shipment instructions to factories

Track shipment progress and follow up on outstanding freight-related tasks

Help ensure shipments move from factory to warehouse according to plan



3PL & Fulfillment Coordination

Create advance shipping notices in the 3PL system

Place fulfillment and transfer orders with the 3PL

Coordinate shipment instructions and operational requirements with warehouse partners

Support inventory transfers to Amazon and other fulfillment destinations

Track open orders, shipments, and warehouse-related tasks

Follow up with the 3PL when issues or delays arise



Supplier & Factory Support

Coordinate routine operational requirements with manufacturing partners

Share carton markings, shipping instructions, and other production-related details

Follow up on required information and open action items

Help maintain clear communication between the internal team and external suppliers



Wholesale & Accounts Receivable Support

Support administrative tasks related to the brand's growing wholesale business

Monitor outstanding customer payments

Follow up with wholesale customers regarding overdue invoices

Maintain accurate records of payment status and outstanding receivables

Escalate unresolved payment issues to the COO as needed

Operational Administration

Maintain operational trackers and records using Google Sheets

Perform data entry and routine system updates

Manage recurring operational tasks across internal and external portals

Keep accurate records of shipments, orders, invoices, and other operational activity

Support the COO with additional day-to-day ecommerce operations tasks as needed



Communication & Workflow Management

Work closely with the COO and founder in a lean internal team

Communicate proactively about open items, delays, and blockers

Follow through on assigned tasks without requiring frequent reminders

Coordinate with factories, 3PLs, freight partners, wholesale customers, and other external stakeholders

Help ensure important operational tasks are completed accurately and on time



Qualifications



Required

Previous experience in ecommerce operations, supply chain coordination, logistics, fulfillment, or a similar operational role

Experience supporting a DTC or ecommerce business

Experience coordinating with 3PLs, warehouses, suppliers, or freight partners

Experience with shipment coordination, fulfillment workflows, or inventory movements

Experience working with an Amazon fulfillment or inventory transfer workflow

Experience with wholesale operations or accounts receivable follow-up

Experience coordinating production or shipments from suppliers in China

Strong proficiency with Google Sheets

Experience working with operational portals, trackers, and web-based systems

Strong written English communication skills

Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Strong organizational and follow-up skills

Ability to manage multiple routine operational tasks independently

Comfortable communicating with external vendors and partners

Ability to follow established processes and execute straightforward tasks consistently

Proactive communication when something is delayed, missing, or requires escalation

Comfortable working within a small, fast-moving ecommerce team

Ability to work with meaningful overlap with US business hours



Preferred

Experience using Flexport or another freight-forwarding platform

Experience with consumer-product brands

Familiarity with QuickBooks or similar accounting software

title: Junior Media Buyer
description:
# Junior Media Buyer



## Role Overview



We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented **Junior Media Buyer** to support the day-to-day execution and management of paid advertising campaigns across our client accounts.



Your main responsibility is to make sure campaigns are launched correctly, budgets are managed according to the scaling strategy, account performance is monitored, and all actions and results are accurately documented.



This is an execution-heavy role for someone who understands paid advertising fundamentals, works quickly, follows systems, and pays strong attention to detail.



## Core Responsibilities



### Ad Launching



* Launch new campaigns, ad sets, and creatives across advertising accounts.

* Follow the campaign structures provided by the Senior Media Buyer or Media Buying Lead.

* Make sure targeting, budgets, URLs, tracking, naming conventions, and creatives are correctly configured before publishing.

* Perform quality-control checks after campaigns go live.

* Ensure new creative batches are launched on schedule.

* Keep advertising accounts clean and properly organized.



### Budget Scaling



* Adjust campaign and ad set budgets according to predefined scaling rules.

* Scale winning campaigns when performance meets the required KPIs.

* Reduce budgets when campaigns fall outside the acceptable performance range.

* Follow daily scaling instructions provided by the Media Buying Lead.

* Avoid unnecessary or emotional budget changes and follow the established system.



### Daily Account Monitoring



Monitor assigned advertising accounts throughout the day and identify:



* Overspending campaigns

* CPA increases

* ROAS drops

* Strong-performing campaigns

* New winning creatives

* Underperforming ads

* Delivery issues

* Tracking problems

* Rejected or restricted ads

* Unusual account activity



Any significant issue should be escalated to the Senior Media Buyer immediately.



### Media Buying Log



Maintain the **Daily Media Buying Log** for every assigned account.



The log should accurately document:



* Daily ad spend

* Revenue

* ROAS

* CPA

* Purchases

* Campaign performance

* Budget increases

* Budget decreases

* Campaigns launched

* Campaigns paused

* New creatives launched

* Winning creatives

* Important observations

* Problems or account issues

* Actions taken during the day



Every major change made inside an advertising account should be documented.



### Creative Performance Tracking



* Monitor the performance of newly launched creatives.

* Identify creatives that are generating strong spend and conversions.

* Track CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CPM, spend, purchases, and other relevant metrics.

* Flag potential winning creatives to the Creative Strategist and Senior Media Buyer.

* Identify creatives that should potentially be paused or replaced.

* Make sure creative testing campaigns remain organized.



### Account Organization



Maintain clean account structures and naming conventions across:



* Campaigns

* Ad sets

* Ads

* Creative testing

* Scaling campaigns



Campaign structures should always be understandable by another team member without requiring additional explanation.



### Daily Reporting



At the end of each working day, provide a short update covering:



* What was launched

* What was scaled

* What was reduced or paused

* Major performance changes

* Winning campaigns or creatives

* Problems encountered

* Anything requiring senior attention

* Priorities for the following day



## Performance Metrics



Performance will primarily be measured based on:



* Accuracy of campaign launches

* Speed of execution

* Accuracy of the Media Buying Log

* Following scaling rules correctly

* Campaign organization

* Identification of performance issues

* Communication speed

* Ability to follow SOPs

* Number of execution mistakes

* Reliability and consistency



## Requirements



The ideal candidate:



* Has a basic understanding of Meta Ads and paid social advertising.

* Understands metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, CPC, CVR, and MER.

* Is comfortable working with advertising budgets.

* Is highly detail-oriented.

* Can follow instructions and SOPs accurately.

* Works quickly without sacrificing accuracy.

* Is comfortable working with spreadsheets and reporting systems.

* Communicates immediately when something appears wrong.

* Can manage multiple advertising accounts simultaneously.

* Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities.



Previous experience with e-commerce advertising is highly preferred.



## What This Role Is Not



This is not initially a senior strategy position.



You will not be expected to independently create the entire media-buying strategy.



Your primary responsibility is **execution**:



**Launch correctly.

Monitor performance.

Scale according to the system.

Maintain the log.

Report problems quickly.**



As your performance and understanding improve, you will gradually receive more responsibility over campaign optimization and media-buying decisions.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



* Hungry to learn

* Extremely reliable

* Organized

* Numbers-driven

* Fast

* Detail-oriented

* Coachable

* Comfortable working under pressure



We value consistency and execution over unnecessary complexity.



The goal is to develop the Junior Media Buyer into someone who can eventually take full ownership of advertising accounts.

title: Book Writer – Non-Fiction Books
description:
About the Role



MarketX Inc. is looking for a skilled and experienced Full-Time Book Writer for BraveMind Publishing, the company’s modern publishing brand.



We are looking for a BOOK WRITER with prior experience working with a publishing company, editorial team, book production team, self-publishing company, or similar professional writing environment. The applicant must have written at least one complete nonfiction, self-help, motivational, educational, or business-related book from cover to cover.



The ideal candidate must be capable of developing, writing, improving, and polishing nonfiction manuscripts in Taglish and/or English for Filipino readers. This role requires strong understanding of book structure, manuscript flow, chapter development, reader engagement, and the overall publishing process.



AI tools may be used as part of research, outline, grammar check and idea development. However, the final manuscript must be human-refined, original, well-structured, natural, practical, and suitable for the target market. We are not looking for someone who simply copies AI-generated content. We need a professional writer who can use AI wisely at its limit while applying creativity, judgment, research, and strong writing skills.



Key Responsibilities

Write nonfiction book manuscripts in Taglish and/or English.

Develop chapter outlines, book flow, titles, subtitles, examples, exercises, and key takeaways.

Improve rough drafts, AI-assisted drafts, and existing manuscript materials.

Make content engaging, practical, relatable, and easy to understand.

Organize ideas into a clear, logical, and reader-friendly book structure.

Write in a tone suitable for Filipino mass-market readers.

Remove repetitive, generic, boring, overly academic, or AI-sounding content.

Research topics, reader problems, examples, and references when needed.

Ensure consistency in tone, message, structure, and chapter flow.

Coordinate with the publishing and editorial team for revisions and improvements.

Revise manuscripts based on feedback, editorial direction, and publishing requirements.

Meet agreed deadlines while maintaining quality output.

Qualifications

Must have experience as a Book Writer, Manuscript Writer, Content Writer, Ghostwriter, or Nonfiction Writer.

Must have written at least one complete nonfiction, self-help, motivational, educational, or business-related book from cover to cover.

Preferably with experience working in a publishing company, book production team, editorial team, or self-publishing company.

Strong background in writing books, ebooks, long-form content, educational materials, or practical guide materials.

Excellent writing, grammar, structure, and content organization skills.

Can write naturally in Taglish and/or English.

Understands Filipino readers and practical nonfiction writing style.

Knowledgeable in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms as part of the writing workflow.

Can improve AI-assisted content instead of simply copying or relying on AI output.

Creative, detail-oriented, organized, and deadline-driven.

Can follow instructions and work independently.

Open to feedback, revisions, and editorial direction.

Preferred Experience



Experience writing or developing any of the following is a strong advantage:



Business books

Self-help books

Motivational books

Educational books

Practical guide books

Filipino or Taglish nonfiction books

Ebooks or printed books for publishing

Social media, marketing, or sales-driven content

AI-assisted manuscript development

Expected Output Per Manuscript



The selected writer may be assigned to produce, improve, or finalize the following:



Chapter outline or improved book structure

Written manuscript draft

Revised manuscript after feedback

Clean final manuscript version

Editorial notes or list of concerns, if any

Research notes or references used, if applicable

Skills Test



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short writing test to assess:



Writing quality

Creativity

Clarity

Grammar

Book structure

Content organization

AI-assisted writing workflow

Ability to write for Filipino readers



The test will be used strictly for SKILLS ASSESMENT PURPOSE ONLY.



How to Apply



Interested applicants may send the following to:







Please include:



Updated resume/CV

Sample written book, ebook, article, or long-form content, if available



Short introduction about your writing and publishing experience

Portfolio or sample manuscript, if available


 Subject Line:

title: Senior Sales Account Manager
description:
SENIOR SALES ACCOUNT MANAGER — U.S. SMALL BUSINESS MARKET



Successful By Choice LLC (SBC) is hiring an experienced Senior Sales Account Manager to sell business services to small businesses throughout the United States.



This is NOT an appointment setter position. We are looking for an experienced sales professional who knows how to have a business conversation, uncover a need, recommend the right solution, handle objections, and close the sale.



POSITION DETAILS



Position: Senior Sales Account Manager

Type: Part-Time | Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–3:00 PM Miami, Florida time

Hours: 30 hours per week

Pay: $6 USD/hour + performance bonuses



The required 9:00 AM–3:00 PM Miami schedule is important because you will be speaking with U.S. small-business owners during their normal business hours.



WHAT YOU WILL SELL



SBC provides services designed to help small businesses establish and improve their professional business presence, including:



Business websites

Professional business

Domains

Web hosting

SSL/security

Website management

Backups

SEO/online presence services

Business printing

Complete business setup packages

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Make outbound calls to qualified business prospects

Speak professionally with business owners and decision-makers

Identify the prospect's actual business needs

Ask effective discovery questions

Recommend the appropriate SBC service or package

Present pricing clearly and confidently

Handle objections and concerns

Follow up with interested prospects

Ask for the sale and close qualified opportunities

Maintain accurate CRM records

Track follow-ups and sales opportunities

Communicate professionally with the SBC team

Consistently work toward sales and revenue goals

OUR SALES PROCESS



OPEN → IDENTIFY NEED → QUALIFY → RECOMMEND → PRESENT PRICE → HANDLE OBJECTIONS → CLOSE → FOLLOW UP



You will be expected to guide the conversation rather than simply read a script.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



This position is for an experienced sales professional.



REQUIRED:



Proven sales experience

Proven outbound phone sales experience

Actual closing experience

Experience speaking with customers or business decision-makers

Strong spoken English

Professional and confident communication

Ability to handle objections without becoming discouraged

Ability to identify customer needs and recommend solutions

Ability to ask for the sale

Strong follow-up and organizational skills

Reliable high-speed internet

Quiet, professional workspace

Ability to work independently

Must be available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–3:00 PM Miami time



B2B sales experience is strongly preferred.



IMPORTANT — THIS IS A CLOSING ROLE



We are not looking for someone whose primary experience is appointment setting.



If your experience is mainly making calls and booking appointments for another salesperson to close, this may not be the right position.



We are looking for someone who can take a qualified prospect from:



“Hello” → “What does your business need?” → “Here is the solution” → “Here is the price” → “Let's get you started.”



You should be comfortable asking for the business.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Please include the following in your application:



Years of sales experience

Types of products/services you have sold

Whether your experience was B2B, B2C, or both

Your outbound calling experience

Your closing experience

Examples of sales results, quotas, or targets you have achieved

Your experience handling objections

Your availability for 9:00 AM–3:00 PM Miami time, Monday–Friday

Confirmation that $6 USD/hour + performance bonuses works for you

A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and briefly describing your sales experience

REQUIRED FIRST LINE



"I CAN WORK 9 AM–3 PM MIAMI TIME."



Applications that do not include this first line may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable part of the SBC sales operation and directly contribute to revenue growth.



Successful By Choice LLC

Because Why Not?

title: Full-Time Video Editor — 3-5 Short Ads Per Day (No Other Clients)
description:
Boost Yours is an Australian performance marketing agency. We run
 and Instagram ad campaigns for local businesses — construction, beauty, medical, education, real estate and hospitality.



We are hiring ONE full-time video editor to produce our daily ad creative.



Please read the whole post before applying. Two things below will disqualify most applicants, and we would rather you know now than after an interview.



----------------------------------------------------------------------

THE WORK

----------------------------------------------------------------------



You will produce 3 to 5 short advertising videos every working day.

That is 15 to 25 videos per week. Each video is 25 to 30 seconds long.



- All footage is supplied by our clients or our shooting team. You will never need to film anything.

- Most videos are vertical (9:16). Some need a 1:1 or 4:5 version as well.

- A large share of the work is variations: one video, cut three or four different ways with different opening hooks for ad testing.

- Every video needs burned-in captions. Most people watch on mute.

- You will report to the Content Lead in Australia. She gives you the brief and the feedback on every single video.

- Australian English only.



----------------------------------------------------------------------

BE HONEST WITH YOURSELF ABOUT THIS PART

----------------------------------------------------------------------



This is repetitive, high-volume production work.



You will not be making a different creative masterpiece every week. You will be making the same kind of 25-30 second ad, over and over, to a template and a brief, for a long time. The editors who do well in this role are the ones who enjoy a fast, repeatable routine and take pride in consistency and speed.



If you are looking for creative variety and one-off passion projects, you will be unhappy here within three months. Please apply somewhere else — no hard feelings.



----------------------------------------------------------------------

THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB

----------------------------------------------------------------------



This is a full-time, exclusive position.



You cannot keep other clients, other agencies, part-time editing work, or ongoing freelance projects alongside this role. If you currently have them, you must be willing to end them before you start.



We are not strict about this to be difficult. 3 to 5 videos a day with revisions uses a full 8-hour day. Editors who try to run other work on the side start missing deadlines in week three, every time. We check this at interview, and we will notice.



If you are not willing to make this your only job, please do not apply.



----------------------------------------------------------------------

SCHEDULE

----------------------------------------------------------------------



Monday to Friday, so we partially overlap with Australian hours. Weekends off. No night shifts.



----------------------------------------------------------------------

YOU MUST HAVE

----------------------------------------------------------------------



- Proven experience editing short-form video for
 or Instagram ADS (not just organic social content, not just YouTube)

- A track record of sustained, high-volume output — tell us the most videos you have ever delivered in a single week

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve — tell us which

- Accurate, well-timed burned-in captions

- Clean audio handling: levels, noise removal, music balance

- Ability to follow a brief exactly and apply revisions without repeating the same mistake

- A computer that can handle daily rendering, reliable internet, and a real backup plan for power cuts and outages

- Clear written English — you will be messaging with Australia daily



----------------------------------------------------------------------

NICE TO HAVE

----------------------------------------------------------------------



- Experience producing multiple hook variations of the same ad for testing

- AI tools for speed: auto-captioning, silence removal, audio clean-up, background removal

- Motion graphics, lower thirds, simple text animation

- Experience with trades, medical, beauty or hospitality clients



----------------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT WE OFFER

----------------------------------------------------------------------



- Full-time, long-term, stable position with an established agency

- [SALARY] per month, paid [twice monthly / monthly]

- Monday to Friday. Weekends off. No night shifts.

- Clear briefs and one point of contact — you are not guessing what we want

- Paid Philippine public holidays [CONFIRM] and paid leave after [___] months

- 13th month pay [CONFIRM]



----------------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

----------------------------------------------------------------------



Applications without these four answers will not be read.



Start your message with the word ORANGE so we know you read the post.



1. A link to your portfolio, showing at least 3 short-form ADS you personally edited. Tell us exactly what you did on each one.



2. The highest number of short videos you have ever finished in a single week, and what they were for.



3. With all footage supplied, how many hours does it take you to finish one 25-30 second ad, start to finish, including captions and rendering? Give a real number.



4. Do you currently have other clients or ongoing freelance work? List them, and tell us whether you can end them before starting.



Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a short test edit — one 25-30 second video from footage and a brief we supply. We do not ask for free work.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



I'm a writer and speaker on AI in innovation and higher education. You'll run my marketing — website, social, content, newsletter, outreach, campaigns, and the numbers behind them.



This job is lead generation. I want to be visible, and I want to be visibly different from everyone else saying the same things about AI. That's what the work is for.



The work is Claude-first: most of it starts as an AI draft that you direct, edit, and publish.



Higher education experience is a plus, not a requirement. I'll bring the subject matter.



HOW THE WORK ACTUALLY GETS DONE



Your job is to edit and post AI content.



Nearly everything — posts, newsletter copy, research, emails, campaign plans — starts as a Claude output. You direct the prompt, edit what comes back, fact-check it, make it sound like me, and publish it. Then you do it again tomorrow.



That's the job. If you're looking for work where you write everything from scratch, this isn't it. If you're already working this way and want more of it, keep reading.



I use Claude myself, daily. I'm not asking you to learn a tool I don't understand — I'll know the difference between a good prompt and a lazy one.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT



Not a virtual assistant role. No calendar management, no inbox triage, no data entry.

Not B2C. All of your experience must be B2B. If your background is ecommerce, dropshipping, or consumer social, this won't translate.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Website and social



Maintain and update the website — pages, posts, speaking and media sections

Run the social channels day to day, LinkedIn first

Create simple graphics (Canva-level)



Content



Edit and publish AI-drafted content across LinkedIn, the website, and social

Launch and run a weekly newsletter — from setup through send



Outreach


 outreach and nurture sequences

Pitch and follow up with podcasts, publications, conferences, and event organizers

Build and maintain the contact lists behind all of it



Campaigns



Plan and run campaigns end to end — book and report launches, events, speaking announcements

Coordinate timing across channels so a launch lands as one thing, not five



Research and engagement



Research topics, sources, and stories to feed the content pipeline

Monitor and respond to comments in real time

Track what's being said in the AI, innovation, and higher-ed conversation and flag what I should weigh in on



Measurement



Track open rates, click rates, traffic, engagement, follower growth, and inbound inquiries

Report weekly: what moved, what didn't, what you're changing next week

I don't want a dashboard. I want to know what to do differently.



Project management



Keep projects moving without me chasing you

Track your own work, own your own deadlines, flag blockers early



REQUIREMENTS



Daily Claude use. Not "I've tried ChatGPT." Actual daily use, and you can show me how you work.

Exceptional organizational skills. You track your own work and I don't have to follow up.

Exceptional speed. Turnaround in hours, not days.

Solid B2B marketing knowledge — integrated marketing, communications, content development, campaign management.

Comfortable with numbers. You read metrics and act on them.

Comfortable with technology. You figure new tools out yourself.

Strong written English. You'll be editing AI output until it stops sounding like AI. That's a real skill and it's most of the job.

Light graphic design. Canva-level is fine.

Overlap with US Pacific business hours — at least four hours a day.



Nice to have: higher education or edtech experience; thought leadership, PR, or editorial background; newsletter operations.



HOURS AND TERMS



Part-time or full-time depending on your skills. Tell me which you want and what you can do.



Paid trial task before anything ongoing.

Labor Estimating

* Identify conditions that may increase labor requirements.

* Consider difficult access, height, phasing, sequencing, and other project conditions that may affect productivity.

Scope Review

* Develop a thorough understanding of the complete rough carpentry scope and identify items that may be missed during a standard material takeoff.

* Account for temporary construction, equipment, hoisting, material handling, cleanup, protection, and layout.

* Identify blocking and backing, fire-treated, and pressure-treated lumber requirements.

* Review special inspection, engineering, and deferred submittal requirements.

* Coordinate rough carpentry scope with structural steel, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other trades.



Estimate Preparation

* Enter quantities accurately into company estimating software and templates.

* Maintain clear supporting documentation for all quantities.

* Clearly document assumptions, exclusions, and clarifications.

* Identify potential cost risks before the estimate is finalized.

* Compare estimates against historical information when available.

* Assist the lead estimator in preparing the final proposal.



Quality Control

* Perform a complete self-review of the takeoff and verify quantities against plans.

* Confirm all buildings and areas have been included.

* Review architectural quantities against structural requirements.

* Confirm plan revisions and addenda have been incorporated.

* Verify that major material quantities are reasonable.

* Check for duplicated or missing scope.

* Clearly identify questionable conditions rather than making unsupported assumptions.

* Maintain organized takeoff files so they can be easily reviewed by another estimator.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* Previous experience estimating rough carpentry, wood framing, or wood-frame construction

* Strong ability to read and interpret architectural and structural construction documents

* Experience performing detailed construction quantity takeoffs

* Strong understanding of wood framing systems and construction sequencing

* Familiarity with lumber, plywood, OSB, engineered wood products, trusses, hardware, and connectors

* Strong mathematical, analytical, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills

* Ability to manage multiple estimates and meet assigned deadlines

* Strong ability to identify scope gaps, discrepancies, and unusual project conditions

* Ability to clearly communicate questions, assumptions, and potential problems

* Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a U.S.-based estimating team

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Bluebeam Revu experience preferred

* Experience with On-Screen Takeoff or similar takeoff software preferred

title: Real Estate Media - Editing Production Assistant (Tue–Sat mornings)
description:
I’m Matt, owner of Borderland Real Estate Media in Brisbane. I shoot the listings on site myself, and you’ll work directly with me. We deliver all of our media to a high standard. Primary photo editing already goes out to an editor. I need one dedicated person to finish each job to my spec so it can go to the agent the same morning.



This is a real editing job — a finisher / production assistant role, not a full editor replacing my primary editor, and not a VA role. The pace is reasonably quick: each morning you’ll QC and finish jobs that were shot the day before, and they need to be delivered that morning before your shift ends. I won’t overload you, but the work does need to move. The business is young and growing (~12–16 listings/month and climbing). Some mornings the queue will be light. You still get paid for the shift. I’ll let you know the night before, and you can use that time for yourself. As volume comes on, those empty mornings will disappear. I want someone who’s on board with work being up and down initially, until we fully grow your role into its capacity. 



The shift:

Tuesday to Saturday, 4 hours in the morning (Philippine time). Sunday and Monday off.

You'll be paid for the shift even if the queue is light - this isn't a gig role. 

Pay: $6–8 USD per hour, depending on skill and speed after a paid trial.

We work in Adobe. You need to be solid in Photoshop and Lightroom, and familiar with Illustrator. Company Adobe login provided — you need your own machine that runs them properly.



A normal listing:

QC about 30 photos back from the primary editor. Use your eye: lawn replacement on a few exteriors, small clutter (cords, a personal photo on a fridge), colour/exposure tweaks, colour temperature fixes, and on twilight shoots fixing the colour of lights in windows so it looks right. 

Drone pins on 3-4 aerials + a property boundary with provided measurements. 

Floor plans and Site Plans: CubiCasa gives a clean black-and-white SVG with measurements. You put it on brand in Illustrator — fonts, floor textures, beds/baths, land size, totals. Not architecture. Don’t skip applying just because you haven’t done loads of floor plans — if you’re familiar with Illustrator, I’ll give you SOPs and videos for exactly how I want them done - they are very process based. Site Plans are usually drawn in illustrator from a top-down drone photo. 

One listing through to delivery is a normal morning. When we’re busy, two in a shift is the standard I want you to grow into. Your creative eye and attention to detail are appreciated, and I still have clear delivery standards that have to be met. You’ll get SOPs plus examples of what’s good and what’s not. Follow those, then use your eye. I do not want to QC your QC.



Must have:

Strong real estate photo editing in Photoshop and Lightroom (before/after portfolio required — I’d love to see examples of your work)

Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator (floor-plan experience is a bonus, not a blocker — training provided)

Reliable English, overlap with Brisbane mornings

You actually notice when grass looks fake, a pin is wrong, or a twilight window light looks off



Nice to have (bonus, not essential): 

The more photo editing skill you bring, the better. Virtual staging, editing from scratch, or other finishing work is a real bonus for the odd job where it helps — but the primary role is QC, drone pins/boundaries, and branded floor plans.



To apply: 

Short intro

Real estate before/after samples (show me your eye)

Anything that shows Illustrator / simple brand or layout work helps, but isn’t required if you’re keen to follow an SOP

Your expected hourly rate within $6–8 USD

Include the word BORDERLAND in your application. 

Paid trial: one real listing (photos + location pins + floor plan).




 to see more about us. 



Thank you for your time!

title: Short form + Long form Video Editor

Our videos are talking head style with a clear story, and the editing is what makes them work. Think of the way Alex Hormozi's videos are cut. Someone talking to camera, and around that a constant layer of motion graphics, animated text, b-roll and visual proof that keeps the viewer watching to the end.



We are looking for one editor who owns this from raw footage to publish ready file. You get the footage and the script, you deliver the finished video and the thumbnail.

Build motion graphics, animated text and transitions that carry the story instead of decorating it

Visualize what is being said. When the script says "you see on screen a ..." the right visual appears at the right second and it looks clean

Replace backgrounds and change the full setting of a shot when the story calls for a different environment

Generate and integrate AI images and AI visuals so they blend with the real footage

A strong portfolio of talking head videos with heavy motion graphics. This is the most important requirement. Applications without a portfolio are not reviewed

Advanced Premiere Pro or Final Cut, plus After Effects for motion graphics

Real experience with background replacement, masking, keying and rotoscoping

Working knowledge of AI image and video tools such as Midjourney, ChatGPT, Runway or Kling, and the taste to make that output look believable next to real footage

Clear written English and the discipline to hit deadlines without being chased



Nice to have



Thumbnail design in Photoshop or Canva

Experience editing for a brand channel or personal brand channel that actually grew

Understanding of YouTube retention and what makes people keep watching



How to apply



Send your application with the following.



A link to your portfolio with at least two talking head videos you edited yourself, with the motion graphics clearly visible

One example where you replaced a background or changed the setting of a shot, and one example where you used AI generated visuals inside an edit
